metadata.title: 30-Minute Intstant Pot Pho Ga
metadata.description: Make great Vietnamese pho ga (chicken noodle soup) in 30 minutes using an instant pot. I freeze individual servings in tupperwares to always have broth on hand.

steps: Heat 30 g ghee in a pressure cooker over high heat. Add medium yellow onions, split in half{2} and 1 small piece thinly sliced ginger, cut sides down. Cook without moving, reducing heat if smoking excessively, until onion and ginger are charred, about 5 minutes.
Add 8 chicken drumsticks for 5 minutes  until browned.
Prepare 4 L water (1 gal) 60 ml fish sauce (1/4 cup) and 25 g brown rock sugar (sub brown sugar)

Prepare dry spice mixture in small bowl on digital scale. Add 3 star anise pods 2 g fennel seed (1 tsp), 2 g coriander seeds (1 teaspoon),1 cinnamon stick, and 4 cloves. Stir for 2 minutes until toasted.
Dump in water mixture and 1 small bunch cilantro to pressure cooker.
Cook in instant pot on high pressure for 20 minutes. Use quick release pressure valve when finished.
Open pressure cooker. Skim any scum off the surface of the broth using a ladle, but leave the small bubbles of fat intact.
ladle broth through a fine mesh strainer into a clean pot and discard solids.  Season broth to taste with more fish sauce and sugar if desired.

To serve, place prepared pho noodles (slightly undercooked){} in individual bowls. Top with chicken legs, small white or yellow onion, and thinly sliced scallions. Pour hot broth over chicken and noodles. Serve immediately, adding herbs, bean sprouts, chiles, 2 lime wedges, and sauces.
Freeze individual servings.

sourceText:

Add @chicken drumsticks{8} for ~{5%minutes}  until browned.

Prepare @water{4%L} (1 gal) @fish sauce{60%ml} (1/4 cup) and @brown rock sugar{25%g} (sub brown sugar)

Dump in water mixture and @small bunch cilantro{1} to pressure cooker.

Cook in instant pot on high pressure for ~{20%minutes}. Use quick release pressure valve when finished.

Open pressure cooker. Skim any scum off the surface of the broth using a ladle, but leave the small bubbles of fat intact.

#ladle broth through a #fine mesh strainer{} into a clean pot and discard solids.  Season broth to taste with more fish sauce and sugar if desired.

To serve, place @prepared pho noodles (slightly undercooked){} in individual bowls. Top with chicken legs, @small white or yellow onion{}, and @thinly sliced scallions{}. Pour hot broth over chicken and noodles. Serve immediately, adding herbs, bean sprouts, chiles, @lime wedges{2}, and sauces.

metadata.title: Adobong Manok at Baboy
metadata.description: Classic Filipino adobo with chicken and pork in a silky, fatty, sour sauce
metadata.long_description: Despite the simplicity of the ingredients, adobo can taste remarkably different from cook to cook based on shifts in proportions and technique. Serve with rice and crunchy cucumber relish.
metadata.longDescription: Despite the simplicity of the ingredients, adobo can taste remarkably different from cook to cook based on shifts in proportions and technique. Serve with rice and crunchy cucumber relish.

sections.title: Marinate
steps: Combine 1 cup white sugarcane vinegar, 1 cup soy sauce, 10 garlic cloves (minced), 2 tsp whole black peppercorns, and 3 bay leaves in a large bowl or pot.
Add 2 lb bone-in chicken thighs and 1 lb pork belly (cut into 2-inch pieces). Toss to coat and marinate for 30 minutes marinating at room temperature, or up to overnight in the fridge.

sections.title: Braise
steps: Transfer the meat and marinade to a large pot. Add 1 cup water and 3 tbsp fruit preserves (blueberry or fig jam works well).
Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce to a simmer. Cover and cook for 35-40 minutes braising until the chicken and pork are tender and cooked through.
> The fruit preserves balance the acidity and add body to the sauce, a common home-cook trick in the Philippines.

sections.title: Reduce and Crisp
steps: Remove the meat from the pot and set aside. Continue simmering the sauce uncovered for 10 minutes reducing until reduced and slightly thickened.
> For crispy edges, pan-fry the meat in 2 tbsp cooking oil in a skillet over high heat until golden before returning it to the sauce.
Return the meat to the reduced sauce and toss to coat. Serve hot.

sourceText:
== Marinate ==

Combine @white sugarcane vinegar{1%cup}, @soy sauce{1%cup}, @garlic cloves{10} (minced), @whole black peppercorns{2%tsp}, and @bay leaves{3} in a #large bowl{} or pot.

Add @bone-in chicken thighs{2%lb} and @pork belly{1%lb} (cut into 2-inch pieces). Toss to coat and marinate for ~marinating{30%minutes} at room temperature, or up to overnight in the fridge.

== Braise ==

Transfer the meat and marinade to a #large pot{}. Add @water{1%cup} and @fruit preserves{3%tbsp} (blueberry or fig jam works well).

Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce to a simmer. Cover and cook for ~braising{35-40%minutes} until the chicken and pork are tender and cooked through.

> The fruit preserves balance the acidity and add body to the sauce, a common home-cook trick in the Philippines.

== Reduce and Crisp ==

Remove the meat from the pot and set aside. Continue simmering the sauce uncovered for ~reducing{10%minutes} until reduced and slightly thickened.

> For crispy edges, pan-fry the meat in 2 tbsp cooking oil in a skillet over high heat until golden before returning it to the sauce.

Return the meat to the reduced sauce and toss to coat. Serve hot.

metadata.title: Aeropress Coffee
metadata.description: Using an Aeropress is the fastest simplest way to brew a single cup of great coffee.

steps: Bring 200 g water (7 oz) to a boil then let cool. Water should be around 200°F.
Weigh out 18 g coffee and grind to a texture slightly finer than sea salt using a coffee grinder.
Insert an aeropress metal filter, with an optional extra aeropress paper filter into the AeroPress's detachable plastic cap.

Use some of your hot water to wet your filter and cap, so the filter adheres to the cap and heats your brewing vessel. Hold the cap by the edges and pour the water very slowly so it can be absorbed by the filter.
Place aeropress on your digital scale with the flared end up, then tare the weight. The numbers on the side of the aeropress should appear upside-down.
Add your ground coffee. Be careful not to spill any grounds into the ring-shaped gutter at the top of the AeroPress.
Start a timer. Add twice the weight of water than you have grounds (e.g., for 18 grams coffee, add 36 g water).
Make sure the coffee is saturated evenly, tamping slightly with the paddle or butter knife if necessary, and let it sit for 30 seconds.
Use the remainder of the hot water to fill the chamber.
After 1 minute has elapsed, stir grounds 10 times to agitate.

Fasten the cap, ensuring it locks into the grooves tightly. Flip the whole assembly over with haste and control. Position it atop your brew vessel and begin applying downward pressure. If the pushing feels too easy, your grind is likely too coarse; if it's very hard to push, chances are the grind is too fine. Your coffee is fully brewed once it begins to make a hissing sound.
Once you've unscrewed the cap, you can pop out the filter and the puck of condensed grounds by simply pushing AeroPress's interior section a final inch.

Use some of your hot water to wet your filter and cap, so the filter adheres to the cap and heats your brewing vessel. Hold the cap by the edges and pour the water very slowly so it can be absorbed by the filter.

Place aeropress on your #digital scale{} with the flared end up, then tare the weight. The numbers on the side of the aeropress should appear upside-down.

Add your ground coffee. Be careful not to spill any grounds into the ring-shaped gutter at the top of the AeroPress.

Start a #timer. Add twice the weight of water than you have grounds (e.g., for 18 grams coffee, add @water{36%g}).

Make sure the coffee is saturated evenly, tamping slightly with the paddle or #butter knife{} if necessary, and let it sit for ~{30%seconds}.

Use the remainder of the hot water to fill the chamber.

After ~{1%minute} has elapsed, stir grounds 10 times to agitate.

Fasten the cap, ensuring it locks into the grooves tightly. Flip the whole assembly over with haste and control. Position it atop your brew vessel and begin applying downward pressure. If the pushing feels too easy, your grind is likely too coarse; if it's very hard to push, chances are the grind is too fine. Your coffee is fully brewed once it begins to make a hissing sound.

metadata.title: Air Fryer Asparagus
metadata.description: Quick and easy asparagus roasted in the air fryer until tender-crisp with garlic and olive oil.

steps: Preheat the air fryer to 400°F (200°C) for 3 minutes preheat.
Trim the woody ends from 1 bunch asparagus.

sections.title: Cook
steps: In a bowl, toss the 1 bunch asparagus with 1 tablespoon olive oil, 2 cloves garlic(minced), salt and pepper to taste until evenly coated.
Place the asparagus in the air fryer basket in a single layer.
Cook for 7-10 minutes cook, depending on the thickness of the spears, until tender and slightly crispy.
> Thicker spears need closer to 10 minutes; thin spears may be done at 7 minutes. Shake the basket halfway through for even cooking.

sections.title: Serve
steps: Optional: sprinkle with lemon zest and grated Parmesan before serving for added flavor.

sourceText:
Preheat the #air fryer{} to 400°F (200°C) for ~preheat{3%minutes}.

Trim the woody ends from @asparagus{1%bunch}.

== Cook ==

In a #bowl{}, toss the @asparagus{1%bunch} with @olive oil{1%tablespoon}, @garlic{2%cloves}(minced), @salt{} and @pepper{} to taste until evenly coated.

Place the asparagus in the air fryer basket in a single layer.

Cook for ~cook{7-10%minutes}, depending on the thickness of the spears, until tender and slightly crispy.

> Thicker spears need closer to 10 minutes; thin spears may be done at 7 minutes. Shake the basket halfway through for even cooking.

== Serve ==

Optional: sprinkle with @lemon zest{} and @grated Parmesan{} before serving for added flavor.

metadata.title: Air Fryer Cauliflower
metadata.description: Crispy, tender cauliflower florets roasted in the air fryer with paprika and cumin.

steps: Cut 1 head cauliflower into florets.

sections.title: Season
steps: In a bowl, toss the cauliflower florets with 2 tablespoons olive oil, 1 teaspoon paprika, 1/2 teaspoon cumin, to taste salt, and to taste black pepper until well coated.

sections.title: Air Fry
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 400°F (200°C) for 5 minutes.
Arrange the cauliflower in the air fryer basket in a single layer. Air fry for 15-20 minutes, shaking the basket every 5 minutes, until the cauliflower is tender and crispy.

sections.title: Serve
steps: Garnish with to taste fresh parsley, chopped, before serving.

sourceText:
Cut @cauliflower{1%head} into florets.

== Season ==

In a #bowl{}, toss the cauliflower florets with @olive oil{2%tablespoons}, @paprika{1%teaspoon}, @cumin{1/2%teaspoon}, @salt{to taste}, and @black pepper{to taste} until well coated.

== Air Fry ==

Preheat the #air fryer{} to 400°F (200°C) for ~{5%minutes}.

Arrange the cauliflower in the air fryer basket in a single layer. Air fry for ~{15-20%minutes}, shaking the basket every ~{5%minutes}, until the cauliflower is tender and crispy.

== Serve ==

Garnish with @fresh parsley{to taste}, chopped, before serving.

metadata.title: Air Fryer Chicken Marsala
metadata.description: Crispy air-fried chicken breasts served over pasta with a rich Marsala wine and mushroom cream sauce.

sections.title: Prep Chicken
steps: Flatten 4 boneless chicken breasts to 1/2-inch thickness. Season with salt and black pepper.
Dredge in 1/2 cup flour, shaking off excess.

sections.title: Air Fry Chicken
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 375°F. Lightly spray the basket with cooking spray.
Mix 2 tbsp melted butter and 2 tbsp olive oil. Brush the mixture onto the chicken.
Cook the chicken in the air fryer for 10-12 minutes, flipping halfway through, until the internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Keep the chicken warm under foil.
> Avoid overcrowding the air fryer; cook in batches if needed. For extra crispy chicken, dip in beaten egg before brushing with butter and oil.

sections.title: Make Marsala Sauce
steps: Sauté 8 oz mushrooms(sliced) in 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat until browned, 5-7 minutes.
Add 2 cloves garlic(minced) and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in 3/4 cup Marsala wine and simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Add 1 cup chicken broth and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in 1/2 cup heavy cream and simmer for 2-3 minutes until thickened.
Add 2 tbsp butter and stir until smooth. Season with salt and black pepper.
> Heavy cream is optional, the sauce is still delicious without it. Add white wine or Dijon mustard for more flavor.

sections.title: Cook Pasta
steps: Boil salted water and cook 12 oz fettuccine or preferred pasta until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain.

sections.title: Combine and Serve
steps: Slice the chicken.
Toss the pasta in the Marsala sauce, using reserved pasta water if needed to adjust consistency.
Top with sliced chicken and mushrooms. Garnish with 2 tbsp chopped parsley and grated Parmesan cheese.
Serve immediately.

sourceText:
== Prep Chicken ==

Flatten @boneless chicken breasts{4} to 1/2-inch thickness. Season with @salt{} and @black pepper{}.

Dredge in @flour{1/2%cup}, shaking off excess.

== Air Fry Chicken ==

Preheat the #air fryer{} to 375°F. Lightly spray the basket with @cooking spray{}.

Mix @melted butter{2%tbsp} and @olive oil{2%tbsp}. Brush the mixture onto the chicken.

Cook the chicken in the #air fryer{} for ~{10-12%minutes}, flipping halfway through, until the internal temperature reaches 165°F.

Keep the chicken warm under foil.

> Avoid overcrowding the air fryer; cook in batches if needed. For extra crispy chicken, dip in beaten egg before brushing with butter and oil.

== Make Marsala Sauce ==

Sauté @mushrooms{8%oz}(sliced) in @olive oil{1%tbsp} over medium-high heat until browned, ~{5-7%minutes}.

Add @garlic{2%cloves}(minced) and cook for ~{1%minute}.

Pour in @Marsala wine{3/4%cup} and simmer for ~{2-3%minutes}.

Add @chicken broth{1%cup} and simmer for ~{5%minutes}.

Stir in @heavy cream{1/2%cup} and simmer for ~{2-3%minutes} until thickened.

Add @butter{2%tbsp} and stir until smooth. Season with @salt{} and @black pepper{}.

> Heavy cream is optional, the sauce is still delicious without it. Add white wine or Dijon mustard for more flavor.

== Cook Pasta ==

Boil salted water and cook @fettuccine{12%oz} or preferred pasta until al dente. Reserve @pasta water{1/2%cup}, then drain.

== Combine and Serve ==

Slice the chicken.

Toss the pasta in the Marsala sauce, using reserved pasta water if needed to adjust consistency.

Top with sliced chicken and mushrooms. Garnish with @chopped parsley{2%tbsp} and @grated Parmesan cheese{}.

Serve immediately.

metadata.title: Air Fryer Garlic Broccolini
metadata.description: Quick and crispy broccolini tossed with garlic and olive oil, air fried until tender with slightly charred tips.

sections.title: Prepare the Broccolini
steps: Rinse and pat dry the 1 bunch broccolini(about 8 oz). Trim the tough ends.

sections.title: Season
steps: In a bowl, toss the 1 bunch broccolini with 1½ tablespoons olive oil, 3 cloves garlic(minced), ¼ teaspoon salt, ¼ teaspoon black pepper, and ½ teaspoon red pepper flakes(optional).

sections.title: Preheat
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 375°F (190°C) for 3 minutes.

sections.title: Air Fry
steps: Place the broccolini in a single layer in the air fryer basket. Cook for 7-10 minutes, shaking halfway through, until stems are tender and tops are slightly crispy.

sections.title: Serve
steps: Transfer to a serving plate. Garnish with 1 teaspoon sesame seeds(optional) and a squeeze of lemon juice from lemon wedges.

sourceText:
== Prepare the Broccolini ==

Rinse and pat dry the @broccolini{1 bunch}(about 8 oz). Trim the tough ends.

== Season ==

In a #bowl{}, toss the @broccolini{1 bunch} with @olive oil{1½%tablespoons}, @garlic{3%cloves}(minced), @salt{¼%teaspoon}, @black pepper{¼%teaspoon}, and @red pepper flakes{½%teaspoon}(optional).

== Preheat ==

Preheat the #air fryer{} to 375°F (190°C) for ~{3%minutes}.

== Air Fry ==

Place the broccolini in a single layer in the air fryer basket. Cook for ~{7-10%minutes}, shaking halfway through, until stems are tender and tops are slightly crispy.

== Serve ==

Transfer to a serving plate. Garnish with @sesame seeds{1%teaspoon}(optional) and a squeeze of @lemon juice{} from lemon wedges.

metadata.title: Air Fryer Miso Salmon
metadata.description: Miso-glazed salmon cooked in the air fryer, sweet, savory, and ready in under 20 minutes.

sections.title: Make the Glaze
steps: In a bowl, whisk together 2 tablespoons white miso paste, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon mirin, 1 teaspoon grated ginger, 1 teaspoon grated garlic, 1 tablespoon honey, and 1 teaspoon sesame oil until smooth.

sections.title: Marinate
steps: Pat the 2 salmon fillets(6-7 oz each) dry with paper towels and place in a shallow dish. Pour the miso mixture over the salmon, coating all sides. Marinate in the refrigerator for 20-40 minutes marinate.

sections.title: Air Fry
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 400°F (200°C) for 3-4 minutes preheat.
Remove the salmon from the marinade, gently brushing off any excess to prevent burning. Lightly spray the air fryer basket with cooking spray.
Place the salmon fillets in the basket skin-side down, making sure not to overcrowd.
Cook at 400°F (200°C) for 8-10 minutes cook. The salmon should flake easily with a fork and reach an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C) at the thickest part.
> For a stronger miso flavor, brush additional glaze on the salmon halfway through cooking.

sections.title: Serve
steps: Garnish with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. Serve immediately with steamed rice and vegetables.
> Cooking times vary by air fryer model and fillet thickness. Keep an eye on the salmon during the last few minutes to avoid overcooking.

sourceText:
== Make the Glaze ==

In a #bowl{}, whisk together @white miso paste{2%tablespoons}, @soy sauce{1%tablespoon}, @mirin{1%tablespoon}, @grated ginger{1%teaspoon}, @grated garlic{1%teaspoon}, @honey{1%tablespoon}, and @sesame oil{1%teaspoon} until smooth.

== Marinate ==

Pat the @salmon fillets{2}(6-7 oz each) dry with paper towels and place in a shallow dish. Pour the miso mixture over the salmon, coating all sides. Marinate in the refrigerator for ~marinate{20-40%minutes}.

== Air Fry ==

Preheat the #air fryer{} to 400°F (200°C) for ~preheat{3-4%minutes}.

Remove the salmon from the marinade, gently brushing off any excess to prevent burning. Lightly spray the air fryer basket with @cooking spray{}.

Place the salmon fillets in the basket skin-side down, making sure not to overcrowd.

Cook at 400°F (200°C) for ~cook{8-10%minutes}. The salmon should flake easily with a fork and reach an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C) at the thickest part.

> For a stronger miso flavor, brush additional glaze on the salmon halfway through cooking.

== Serve ==

Garnish with @sesame seeds{} and @sliced green onions{}. Serve immediately with steamed rice and vegetables.

> Cooking times vary by air fryer model and fillet thickness. Keep an eye on the salmon during the last few minutes to avoid overcooking.

metadata.title: Air Fryer Steak
metadata.description: Juicy ribeye or sirloin steaks cooked in the air fryer, seasoned with garlic powder, onion powder, and herbs.

sections.title: Prep the Steaks
steps: Pat the 2 ribeye or sirloin steaks(about 1 inch thick) dry with paper towels. Brush both sides with 1 tablespoon olive oil.

Season both sides with to taste salt, to taste black pepper, 1 teaspoon garlic powder, 1 teaspoon onion powder, and 1 teaspoon dried thyme or rosemary(optional). Let sit at room temperature for 10-15 minutes.

sections.title: Preheat Air Fryer
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 400°F (200°C) for 3-5 minutes.

sections.title: Cook the Steaks
steps: Place the steaks in the air fryer basket in a single layer.
Air fry for 7-9 minutes for medium-rare, 10-12 minutes for medium, or 13-15 minutes for medium-well, flipping halfway through the cooking time.
> Use a meat thermometer to check the internal temperature: 125°F (52°C) for medium-rare, 135°F (57°C) for medium, and 145°F (63°C) for medium-well.
> For a more caramelized crust, sear the steaks briefly in a hot skillet after air frying.

sections.title: Rest the Steaks
steps: Remove steaks from the air fryer and let them rest for 5 minutes to allow the juices to redistribute.

sections.title: Serve
steps: Optionally, top each steak with to taste butter(optional) for extra flavor. Serve immediately with your favorite side dishes.
> Adjust seasoning to your taste or try a steak seasoning blend.

sourceText:
== Prep the Steaks ==

Pat the @ribeye or sirloin steaks{2}(about 1 inch thick) dry with paper towels. Brush both sides with @olive oil{1%tablespoon}.

Season both sides with @salt{to taste}, @black pepper{to taste}, @garlic powder{1%teaspoon}, @onion powder{1%teaspoon}, and @dried thyme or rosemary{1%teaspoon}(optional). Let sit at room temperature for ~{10-15%minutes}.

== Preheat Air Fryer ==

Preheat the #air fryer{} to 400°F (200°C) for ~{3-5%minutes}.

== Cook the Steaks ==

Place the steaks in the #air fryer{} basket in a single layer.

Air fry for ~{7-9%minutes} for medium-rare, ~{10-12%minutes} for medium, or ~{13-15%minutes} for medium-well, flipping halfway through the cooking time.

> Use a meat thermometer to check the internal temperature: 125°F (52°C) for medium-rare, 135°F (57°C) for medium, and 145°F (63°C) for medium-well.

> For a more caramelized crust, sear the steaks briefly in a hot skillet after air frying.

== Rest the Steaks ==

Remove steaks from the #air fryer{} and let them rest for ~{5%minutes} to allow the juices to redistribute.

== Serve ==

Optionally, top each steak with @butter{to taste}(optional) for extra flavor. Serve immediately with your favorite side dishes.

> Adjust seasoning to your taste or try a steak seasoning blend.

metadata.title: Air-Fryer Chicken Parmesan
metadata.description: Simple and quick chicken parmesan made in an air fryer, perfect for a busy weeknight meal.

steps: Carefully butterfly 2 large chicken breasts.
Season both sides with 1 tsp kosher salt and 1 tsp black pepper.
Place 1/3 cup all-purpose flour in a shallow bowl. Season with a large pinch of 1 pinch kosher salt and a few grinds of 1 pinch black pepper.
In another shallow bowl, beat 2 large eggs to blend.
In a third shallow bowl, combine 1 cup panko bread crumbs, 1/4 cup parmesan cheese, 1 tsp oregano, 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes, and 1/2 tsp garlic powder.

Working one at a time, coat 2 chicken breasts in flour, shaking off any excess. Dip into egg, letting excess drip off, then finally dip into panko mixture, gently pressing to adhere and ensuring both sides of chicken are well coated.
Arrange chicken in a single layer in an air-fryer basket. Cook for 5 minutes at 400°F, turning once.
Top chicken with 1 cup marinara sauce and 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese. Continue to cook for 3 minutes at 400°F until cheese is melted and golden.
Divide chicken among plates. Garnish with 2 tbsp fresh parsley.

sourceText:

Season both sides with @kosher salt{1%tsp} and @black pepper{1%tsp}.

Place @all-purpose flour{1/3%cup} in a #shallow bowl{}. Season with a large pinch of @kosher salt{1%pinch} and a few grinds of @black pepper{1%pinch}.

In another #shallow bowl{}, beat @eggs{2%large} to blend.

In a third #shallow bowl{}, combine @panko bread crumbs{1%cup}, @parmesan cheese{1/4%cup}, @oregano{1%tsp}, @red pepper flakes{1/2%tsp}, and @garlic powder{1/2%tsp}.

Working one at a time, coat @chicken breasts{2} in flour, shaking off any excess. Dip into egg, letting excess drip off, then finally dip into panko mixture, gently pressing to adhere and ensuring both sides of chicken are well coated.

Arrange chicken in a single layer in an #air-fryer basket{}. Cook for ~{5%minutes} at 400°F, turning once.

Top chicken with @marinara sauce{1%cup} and @shredded mozzarella cheese{1%cup}. Continue to cook for ~{3%minutes} at 400°F until cheese is melted and golden.

Divide chicken among plates. Garnish with @fresh parsley{2%tbsp}.

metadata.title: All Purpose Barbecue Sauce
metadata.description: Good general purpose sweet bbq sauce

steps: In a medium saucepan, stir together 108 g brown sugar, 272 g ketchup, 63 g molasses, 60 ml white distilled vinegar, 10 g garlic powder, 7 g smoked paprika, 4 g cayenne pepper, 15 ml Worcestershire sauce, 18 g kosher salt, and 3 g black pepper.
Place over medium heat, and let the mixture come to a simmer.
Once simmering, continue cooking, stirring occasionally, for 8 minutes, or until reduced and thickened slightly.

Pour the barbecue sauce into a bowl. If you have a smoking gun, cover the bowl with plastic wrap and slide the probe of the gun into the bowl. Fill the bowl with smoke, and remove the probe. Let sit, covered, for 5 minutes. Stir, taste, and repeat 2 or 3 more times until smoky to your liking.
Serve how you like it! Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 month.

Place over medium heat, and let the mixture come to a simmer.

Once simmering, continue cooking, stirring occasionally, for ~{8%minutes}, or until reduced and thickened slightly.

metadata.title: Aloo Gobi (Potato & Cauliflower Curry)
metadata.description: A simple vegetarian Indian dish with potatoes, cauliflower, and a mix of spices such as turmeric and cumin. Serve as a starter, side dish, or healthy main with naan bread or rice.

sections.title: Roast the Veggies
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Arrange 1 large cauliflower(cut into florets) and 1 pound potatoes(cut into bite-size pieces) on a baking sheet.
Toss with 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1 teaspoon salt, and 2 pinch black pepper. Bake for 30 minutes bake or until slightly charred.

sections.title: Make the Curry Sauce
steps: In the meantime, heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add 3/4 teaspoon cumin seeds and toast for 30 seconds toast or until they dance in the pan.
Add 1 large yellow onion(chopped) and fry for 5 minutes fry onion.
Add 1 teaspoon turmeric powder, 1 teaspoon ground coriander, 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes, 3 cloves garlic(grated), and 1 inch ginger(grated). Keep frying for about 1 minute fry spices.

sections.title: Simmer
steps: Add 2 cups water and a pinch of salt. Simmer on low heat for 15 minutes simmer.

sections.title: Combine
steps: Add the roasted potatoes, cauliflower, and 1 teaspoon garam masala to the sauce. Toss gently until everything turns golden.

sections.title: Serve
steps: Serve with 1 handful cilantro, 4 wedges lemon, and a dollop of plain yogurt. Side with roti, naan bread, or basmati rice.

sourceText:
== Roast the Veggies ==

Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Arrange @cauliflower{1%large}(cut into florets) and @potatoes{1%pound}(cut into bite-size pieces) on a #baking sheet{}.

Toss with @olive oil{1%tablespoon}, @salt{1%teaspoon}, and @black pepper{2%pinch}. Bake for ~bake{30%minutes} or until slightly charred.

== Make the Curry Sauce ==

In the meantime, heat @olive oil{2%tablespoons} in a #large skillet{} over medium heat. Add @cumin seeds{3/4%teaspoon} and toast for ~toast{30%seconds} or until they dance in the pan.

Add @yellow onion{1%large}(chopped) and fry for ~fry onion{5%minutes}.

Add @turmeric powder{1%teaspoon}, @ground coriander{1%teaspoon}, @red pepper flakes{1/4%teaspoon}, @garlic{3%cloves}(grated), and @ginger{1%inch}(grated). Keep frying for about ~fry spices{1%minute}.

== Simmer ==

Add @water{2%cups} and a pinch of @salt{}. Simmer on low heat for ~simmer{15%minutes}.

== Combine ==

Add the roasted potatoes, cauliflower, and @garam masala{1%teaspoon} to the sauce. Toss gently until everything turns golden.

== Serve ==

Serve with @cilantro{1%handful}, @lemon{4%wedges}, and a dollop of plain yogurt. Side with roti, naan bread, or basmati rice.

metadata.title: Aloo Tikka Chaat
metadata.description: Little patties made of aloo (potato), formed into tikki and layered with various chaat toppings
metadata.long_description: The fried chickpeas add delicious pop and crunch. Some of the toppings are the same as for dahi bhalla chaat, which is helpful to know if you are planning on making both!
metadata.longDescription: The fried chickpeas add delicious pop and crunch. Some of the toppings are the same as for dahi bhalla chaat, which is helpful to know if you are planning on making both!

sections.title: Make the Aloo Tikki
steps: Boil 500 g floury potatoes (skin on) in salted water until tender, about 20 minutes boiling. Drain and let cool slightly, then peel and mash.
Mix in 12 g cornflour, 1 tsp fine sea salt, and 1/3 tsp ground white pepper. Divide into 8 portions and shape each into a flat round patty.
Heat 60 g ghee in a large frying pan over medium heat. Shallow-fry the tikki in batches for 3-4 minutes frying per side until golden and crisp. Drain on a wire rack.

sections.title: Crispy Chickpeas
steps: Drain and pat dry 200 g canned chickpeas. Toss with 20 g cornflour, 20 g strong white bread flour, and a pinch fine sea salt until evenly coated.
Heat 250 ml vegetable oil in a small saucepan to 350°F. Fry the chickpeas in batches for 3-4 minutes frying until crisp and golden. Drain on paper towels.

sections.title: Assemble the Chaat
steps: Place 2 tikki on each plate. Spoon over 120 g plain yogurt (whisked smooth), 2 tbsp tamarind chutney, and 2 tbsp mint-coriander chutney.
Scatter over the crispy chickpeas, 1 red onion (finely diced), 30 g pomegranate seeds, and 20 g sev.
Finish with a pinch of chaat masala and serve immediately.

metadata.title: Amish Dinner Rolls
metadata.description: Dense yet tender, moist soft dinner rolls made with mashed potato. They stay fresh at room temperature for several days, making them great for make-ahead.
metadata.long_description: Inspired by a small handwritten Amish cookbook. Mashed potato gives these rolls their soft texture and staying power: they'll remain moist and fresh-tasting at room temperature for several days. One medium-to-large baking potato will yield about 227g of mashed potato.
metadata.longDescription: Inspired by a small handwritten Amish cookbook. Mashed potato gives these rolls their soft texture and staying power: they'll remain moist and fresh-tasting at room temperature for several days. One medium-to-large baking potato will yield about 227g of mashed potato.

sections.title: Make the Dough
steps: Weigh your 4 1/4 cups all-purpose flour(510g); or measure it by gently spooning it into a cup, then sweeping off any excess.

In a bowl, mix and knead together 2 large eggs, 1/3 cup granulated sugar(67g), 2 teaspoons table salt(12g), 6 tablespoons butter(85g, softened), 1 cup mashed potatoes(213g, unseasoned, lightly packed), 2 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast, 3/4 cup lukewarm water(170g), and the 4 1/4 cups all-purpose flour, by hand, mixer, or bread machine set on the dough cycle, to make a smooth, soft dough.
> If possible, use the water in which the potatoes were boiled.

sections.title: First Rise
steps: Place the dough in a lightly greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let the dough rise until doubled in bulk, about 90 minutes first rise.
> If using a bread machine, allow the machine to complete its cycle, then leave the dough in the machine until doubled, perhaps an additional 30 minutes.

sections.title: Shape the Rolls
steps: Gently deflate the dough and divide it into 16 large balls or 24 smaller balls. Round each ball into a smooth roll.
Place the rolls in a lightly greased 9" x 13" baking pan. Cover with lightly greased plastic wrap.

sections.title: Second Rise
steps: Let the rolls rise until quite puffy, 1 1/2-2 hours second rise. Towards the end of the rising time, preheat the oven to 350°F.

sections.title: Bake
steps: Bake the rolls for 20-25 minutes bake, until golden brown and feel set. Remove from the oven and turn out of the pan onto a cooling rack. Brush with melted butter if desired.

> Bake the rolls rather tightly spaced in a 9" x 13" pan so they crowd each other and become pull-apart rolls with unbrowned sides. For round rolls browned all over, place them in a larger pan farther apart.

sections.title: Serve
steps: Serve rolls warm or at room temperature. Store well wrapped in plastic for several days at room temperature; freeze for longer storage.

metadata.title: Apple Challah
metadata.description: Harvest Apple Challah, tender, slightly sweet round challah filled with cinnamon-sugar apples. Traditionally eaten at Rosh Hashanah with honey for a sweet new year.

sections.title: Dough
steps: Weigh your flour; or measure it by gently spooning it into a cup, then sweeping off any excess. Mix together all of the dough ingredients: 1/2 cup water(113g, lukewarm), 6 tablespoons vegetable oil(74g, safflower preferred), 1/4 cup honey(85g), 2 large eggs, 4 cups all-purpose flour(480g), 1 1/2 teaspoons table salt(9g), and 1 tablespoon instant yeast(9g).

Knead the dough in your stand mixer at medium-low speed for 6 minutes, or by hand for 8 minutes. The dough should be soft and elastic. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let it rise for 2 hours rise, or until puffy; when you poke the dough with your finger, the dent will remain and not bounce back. If you've made the dough in a bread machine, allow it to rise in the machine for an extra hour after the dough cycle is completed.

sections.title: Prepare the Pan
steps: Lightly grease a 9" round cake pan that's at least 2" deep, or a 9" or 10" tube pan.

sections.title: Filling
steps: Gently deflate the risen dough, transfer it to a lightly greased work surface, and flatten it into an 8" x 10" rectangle.
Toss 3 cups apples(340g, cored but unpeeled, cut in 3/4" chunks) with 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon and 1/4 cup granulated sugar(50g).

sections.title: Assemble
steps: Spread half the apple mixture in the center of the dough. Fold one short edge over the apples to cover them, patting the edges firmly to seal the apples inside.
Spread the remaining filling on top of the folded-over dough. Cover with the other side of the dough, again patting firmly and pinching the edges to seal.
Using a bench knife, cut the apple-filled dough in half lengthwise, then in eight strips across the short length. This will be messy, with some apples falling out.
Transfer the portions of dough and any stray apples to the prepared pan, forming a single layer across the bottom. Stack more dough on top of the first layer if needed to fit them all in.

sections.title: Final Rise
steps: Cover with greased plastic wrap or the reusable wrap of your choice, and let rise for about 1 hour rise, until puffy looking. Toward the end of the rise time, preheat your oven to 325°F with a rack in the lower third.

sections.title: Bake
steps: When the dough has risen, uncover it and brush with 1 large egg beaten with 1 tablespoon water. Sprinkle with coarse sparkling sugar (optional). Bake the challah for 55-65 minutes bake, until it's a deep golden brown. Some of the top pieces may caramelize; that's OK.
> Use an instant-read thermometer if you have one; the center should reach 190°F.

sections.title: Cool and Serve
steps: Remove the challah from the oven and place it (still in the pan) on a rack for 5 minutes. After this rest, remove the challah from the pan and return it to the rack. Serve warm, drizzled with honey.
Store covered at room temperature for up to three days; freeze for longer storage.

> Be sure to use good-quality honey and oil in this recipe. Since they play such a major part, they have to taste good. Safflower oil is preferred as it's neutral-flavored. Canola oil can produce off flavors in baking, so best not to use it here.

metadata.title: Apple Pie From Scratch
metadata.description: A classic apple pie recipe with a flaky crust and a cinnamon-spiced apple filling

steps: In a medium-sized bowl, mix 2.5 cups flour and 1 tsp salt. Add 1.5 sticks butter, cold and cubed, and break up into the flour with a fork until lumps are about the size of small peas.
Gradually add 8 tbsp ice water and continue to mix until the dough starts to come together, adding more water if the dough is too dry.
Work the dough together with your hands and turn out onto a surface. Form into a ball, cover with cling wrap, and refrigerate.

Peel, core, and slice 2.5 lb granny smith apples. In a bowl, mix the sliced apples with 0.75 cup sugar, 2 tbsp flour, 0.5 tsp salt, 1 tsp cinnamon, 0.25 tsp nutmeg, and juice from 0.5 lemon. Refrigerate the mixture.
Preheat oven to 375°F (200°C).

On a floured surface, cut the pie dough in half and roll out both halves until about ⅛-inch (3 mm) thick. Roll one dough half around the rolling pin and unroll onto a pie dish, trimming extra if necessary.
Pour in apple filling mixture and pat down. Roll the other half of the dough on top. Trim excess dough from edges and pinch the edges to create a crimp, ensuring they are sealed together.
Brush the pie with 1 whole egg and sprinkle with 1 tbsp sugar. Cut four slits in the top of the pie to create a vent.
Bake the pie for 55 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
Cool completely before slicing. Serve topped with a scoop of 1 scoop vanilla ice cream.

metadata.title: Applesauce Oatmeal Bread
metadata.description: A moist and flavorful oatmeal bread made with applesauce, spices, and walnuts. Great for breakfast with a smear of cream cheese.

steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Lightly grease a 9" x 5" loaf pan.
In a large bowl, mix together 1 cup granulated sugar, 2 large eggs, 1/2 cup vegetable oil, and 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract.

In a separate bowl, whisk together 1/2 cup whole wheat flour, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 teaspoon baking powder, 1/2 teaspoon baking soda, 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon, 1/2 teaspoon allspice, 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg, and 1/2 teaspoon table salt. Add the dry mixture to the wet ingredients and stir until just combined.
Fold in 1/2 cup rolled oats, 3/4 cup applesauce, and 1/2 cup chopped walnuts.
Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan. Bake for 55-60 minutes baking until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
> A light sprinkling of oats on top of the batter before baking tells people about the goodness within.
Cool completely in the pan. Store well wrapped at room temperature for several days; freeze for longer storage.
> You can substitute quick-cooking oats for old-fashioned rolled oats.

metadata.title: Asian Steak Stir Fry in the Air Fryer
metadata.description: Asian-style steak stir fry cooked in the air fryer with a savory sweet sauce.

sections.title: Steak
steps: Slice 1 lb flank steak (or sirloin) into thin strips about 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick, against the grain.
Toss with 1/4 cup cornstarch and 1/4 tsp baking soda (optional, for tenderizing). The mixture will be slightly sticky.

sections.title: Marinade
steps: In a bowl, combine 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp minced garlic, 1 tsp minced ginger, and 1 tsp brown sugar.
Toss with the sliced steak and marinate for at least 30 minutes, up to 2 hours.

sections.title: Cook the Steak
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 400F (200C) for 3 minutes.
After marinating, toss steak with 1/4 cup cornstarch until evenly coated.
Lay steak strips flat in the air fryer basket. Spray generously with oil spray.
Cook for 7 minutes to 10 minutes, shaking the basket every 2 minutes to 3 minutes. Work in batches to avoid overcrowding.

sections.title: Sauce
steps: Heat 2 tsp oil in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add 4 cloves garlic (minced) and 2 tsp minced ginger; saute for 30 seconds.

Add 1/2 cup soy sauce (low sodium preferred), 1/2 cup water, 1/2 cup brown sugar to 3/4 cup brown sugar, 2 tbsp rice vinegar (optional), and 1/2 tsp chili garlic sauce to 1 tsp chili garlic sauce (adjust to taste).
Bring to a gentle boil.
Stir in 2 tsp cornstarch dissolved in 2 tbsp cold water and simmer until thickened, 1 minute to 2 minutes.

sections.title: Combine and Serve
steps: Transfer cooked steak to a bowl. Toss with the sauce and let sit for 5 minutes.
Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds. Serve over rice or with your favorite vegetables.
> Thinly sliced vegetables like carrots, onions, and bell peppers make great additions.

metadata.title: Asian-Style Oven-Baked Pork Belly
metadata.description: Crispy oven-baked pork belly with five-spice, soy, and hoisin glaze.

ingredients.name: pork belly dry with paper towels

sections.title: Prep the Pork Belly
steps: Preheat your oven to 375°F.
Score the skin of the 2 pounds pork belly in a crosshatch pattern, being careful not to cut into the meat.
> Scoring helps the fat render and the skin crisp up.
Pat the pork belly dry with paper towels.

sections.title: Season the Pork
steps: In a small bowl, mix together the 2 tablespoons sea salt, 1 tablespoon black pepper, 1 tablespoon five-spice powder, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons hoisin sauce, 1 tablespoon rice vinegar, 1 tablespoon honey, 4 minced garlic cloves, and 1 inch piece%minced ginger.
Rub the mixture all over the pork belly, ensuring it is well coated, especially in the scored areas.

sections.title: Bake the Pork Belly
steps: Place the pork belly on a wire rack set in a roasting pan, skin side up.
Roast in the oven for 75 minutes, or until the skin is golden and crispy.
> If the skin is not crisping up, switch to broil for the last 5-10 minutes, but keep a close eye on it to avoid burning.

sections.title: Rest and Serve
steps: Remove the pork belly from the oven and let rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing.
Garnish with 2 chopped green onions and serve with steamed rice, pickled vegetables, or a simple salad.

metadata.title: Authentic Hoagie Rolls
metadata.description: Crusty, chewy hoagie rolls perfect for submarine sandwiches. Requires two rises and steam baking for authentic texture.

sections.title: Initial Dough Preparation
steps: Warm 2.25 cups milk to 105-110F (about 50 seconds in the microwave).
Mix warm milk with 2.5 tsp active dry yeast and 1 tbsp malted milk powder.
Let stand 4 minutes until foamy. > If no foam appears, the yeast may be dead, start over with fresh yeast.
In a large mixing bowl, combine 6.75 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tbsp honey, 3 tbsp olive oil, and 1 tbsp salt.
Add the proofed yeast mixture.
Mix vigorously by hand until cohesive, 2 minutes.
Cover with plastic wrap and rest 15 minutes.

sections.title: Kneading and First Rise
steps: Turn dough onto a clean counter. > Avoid wooden surfaces, they absorb moisture from the dough.
Knead 9 minutes until smooth and no longer sticky. > Test for gluten window: dough should stretch thin without tearing.
Place in the large mixing bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise 50 minutes until doubled.

sections.title: Shaping
steps: Punch down the dough.
Divide into 4 pieces, 175g each hoagie roll dough.
Press each portion into an 8-inch wide by 1-inch thick rectangle.
Roll tightly from bottom to top and seal the seam on the bottom.
Roll into a 10-inch cylinder.
Place on a baking sheet dusted with 1 tbsp cornmeal.
Cover with plastic wrap or a towel and proof 50 minutes until 1.5 to 2 times larger.

sections.title: Baking Preparation
steps: Preheat the oven to 375F. Place an empty oven-safe pan on the bottom rack.
Score rolls with one diagonal slash at a 45-degree angle using a bread lame or sharp knife.
Mix 1 egg white with 1 tbsp water.
Brush rolls with the egg wash using a pastry brush.
Sprinkle additional 1 tsp cornmeal on top.

sections.title: Baking
steps: Place rolls on the middle rack.
Add 1 cup ice cubes to the bottom pan for steam.
Bake 10 minutes, then rotate the pan.
Bake another 9 minutes until golden brown. > Internal temperature should reach 200F.
Cool completely on a wire cooling rack.
> Store in a plastic bag for 24 hours before using for best texture.

sourceText:
== Initial Dough Preparation ==

Warm @milk{2.25%cups} to 105-110F (about ~{50%seconds} in the microwave).

Mix warm milk with @active dry yeast{2.5%tsp} and @malted milk powder{1%tbsp}.

Let stand ~{4%minutes} until foamy. > If no foam appears, the yeast may be dead, start over with fresh yeast.

In a #large mixing bowl{}, combine @all-purpose flour{6.75%cups}, @honey{1%tbsp}, @olive oil{3%tbsp}, and @salt{1%tbsp}.

Add the proofed yeast mixture.

Mix vigorously by hand until cohesive, ~{2%minutes}.

Cover with #plastic wrap{} and rest ~{15%minutes}.

== Kneading and First Rise ==

Turn dough onto a clean counter. > Avoid wooden surfaces, they absorb moisture from the dough.

Knead ~{9%minutes} until smooth and no longer sticky. > Test for gluten window: dough should stretch thin without tearing.

Place in the #large mixing bowl{}, cover with #plastic wrap{}, and let rise ~{50%minutes} until doubled.

== Shaping ==

Punch down the dough.

Divide into @hoagie roll dough{4 pieces, 175g each}.

Press each portion into an 8-inch wide by 1-inch thick rectangle.

Roll tightly from bottom to top and seal the seam on the bottom.

Roll into a 10-inch cylinder.

Place on a #baking sheet{} dusted with @cornmeal{1%tbsp}.

Cover with #plastic wrap{} or a towel and proof ~{50%minutes} until 1.5 to 2 times larger.

== Baking Preparation ==

Preheat the #oven{} to 375F. Place an empty #oven-safe pan{} on the bottom rack.

Score rolls with one diagonal slash at a 45-degree angle using a #bread lame{} or sharp knife.

Mix @egg white{1} with @water{1%tbsp}.

Brush rolls with the egg wash using a #pastry brush{}.

Sprinkle additional @cornmeal{1%tsp} on top.

== Baking ==

Place rolls on the middle rack.

Add @ice cubes{1%cup} to the bottom pan for steam.

Bake ~{10%minutes}, then rotate the pan.

Bake another ~{9%minutes} until golden brown. > Internal temperature should reach 200F.

Cool completely on a #wire cooling rack{}.

> Store in a plastic bag for 24 hours before using for best texture.

metadata.title: BA Morning Buns
metadata.description: Bon Appetit's best morning buns, yeasted dough rolled with brown sugar, cinnamon, cardamom, and honey, baked in muffin tins until golden.
metadata.author: Claire Saffitz
metadata.longDescription: This recipe halves easily. The dough needs an overnight chill (8-16 hours).

sections.title: Make the Dough
steps: Whisk 1 packet active dry yeast (about 2.25 tsp), 1 cup whole milk (warmed), and 1 tsp honey in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment. Let sit until foamy, about 5 minutes proofing.

Add 3 large egg whites, 2 cups bread flour, and additional 1/4 cup honey. Beat on medium-high until the mixture is very light and thick, about 3 minutes mixing. Scrape mixture back into the bottom of the bowl.

Sprinkle 1 cup whole wheat flour and 1 1/2 cups bread flour over the top, do not stir. Place the bowl in a warm spot uncovered until the mixture bubbles up around the flour, about 30-40 minutes resting.

Add 2 tsp Diamond Crystal kosher salt, 2 tsp orange zest (optional), 2 tsp vanilla extract, 4 large egg yolks (from the separated eggs plus 1 extra yolk), and 1/4 cup whole milk (chilled). Mix with the dough hook on low until a shaggy dough forms.
Increase to medium speed and knead for 8-10 minutes kneading until smooth, soft, and elastic. If still very sticky after 5 minutes, add bread flour a tablespoon at a time until just tacky.
Reduce to medium-low and add 1 cup unsalted butter (2 sticks, room temperature, cut into pieces) one piece at a time, letting each absorb fully before adding the next.
Cover and chill for 8-16 hours chill.

sections.title: Make the Filling
steps: Cook 3/4 cup light brown sugar, 1 tbsp ground cinnamon, 3/4 tsp ground cardamom, 1/4 cup honey, and 8 tbsp unsalted butter in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly, just until the butter melts and the mixture is smooth. Let cool.

sections.title: Shape the Buns
steps: Punch down the dough and turn out onto a lightly floured surface. Divide in half; return one piece to the bowl, cover, and chill.

Roll the remaining piece on a sheet of lightly floured parchment paper to a rough 16x12 inch rectangle. Spread half the brown sugar mixture over the dough. Starting from a long side closest to you, roll into a tight log, using the parchment to help.
> If the dough gets too warm or sticky, slide it onto a baking sheet and chill until firm.
Place seam side down on a rimmed baking sheet and chill until firm, about 20-30 minutes chill. Repeat with the second half of dough and remaining filling.
Spray the cups of two 12-cup muffin pans with nonstick spray.

Trim the chilled logs about 1/2 inch from the ends. Cut each log on a slight diagonal into 12 equal pieces. Place cut side up in the prepared muffin cups. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and let sit at room temperature until puffed and expanded to the edges of the cups, about 25-35 minutes proofing.

sections.title: Bake
steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F with a rack in the center.
Bake the buns, rotating pans once, until golden brown all over, about 20-25 minutes baking.

sections.title: Glaze
steps: While the buns bake, heat 4 tbsp unsalted butter and 1/4 cup honey in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring until smooth. Remove from heat.
Pull the buns from the oven and brush tops with the butter-honey mixture. Sprinkle with sanding sugar.
Transfer buns to a wire rack immediately, if the sugar cools in the pan it will harden and stick. Let cool.

metadata.title: Bacon Onion Rye Rolls
metadata.description: A savory spin on a filled roll featuring a buttery, tender rye dough wrapped around a flavorful bacon-and-onion filling. Inspired by Bernard Clayton's New Complete Book of Breads.

sections.title: Dough
steps: Weigh your flour; or measure it by gently spooning it into a cup, then sweeping off any excess.

In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, combine 1 cup milk, 4 tablespoons butter (melted), 1 large egg plus 1 large egg yolk (reserve the white for the filling), 3 3/4 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup rye flour, 2 tablespoons granulated sugar, 2 teaspoons instant yeast, and 1 1/2 teaspoons table salt. Mix just until the dough starts to leave the sides of the bowl.
> Also known as whole rye flour, you can use rye flour blend, white rye flour, organic medium rye, or pumpernickel flour.
Cover the bowl and let the mixture rest for 15 minutes for the flour to absorb the liquid; this will make the dough easier to knead.
After the rest, switch to the dough hook and knead until the dough is smooth and slightly sticky, about 7 minutes.
Place the dough in a lightly greased bowl or 8-cup measure, cover, and let rise for 1 hour, or until it's increased in volume by at least a third.

sections.title: Filling
steps: Fry (or bake in a 350°F oven for 35 minutes) the 1 pound bacon until crisp. Drain the bacon and reserve 2 tablespoons bacon fat.

Place the reserved fat in a large skillet over medium heat. Add 4 cups onions (peeled and chopped) and cook for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden brown. Remove from the heat and let cool to room temperature.
Crumble the cooled bacon and add it to the onions. Stir in 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour and the reserved 1 large egg white.

sections.title: Assembly
steps: Grease a 9" x 13" baking pan or two 9" round baking pan.

Deflate the risen dough and roll it into a 12" x 18" rectangle. Spread the filling over the dough, leaving 1" of one long edge uncovered. Roll up the dough toward the uncovered edge and pinch it closed to seal it.
Cut the dough into 1" slices; lay them cut side up in the prepared pan(s). Cover and let the rolls rise for about 1 hour, until puffy. Toward the end of the rising time, preheat the oven to 375°F.

sections.title: Bake
steps: Uncover the rolls and bake for about 25 minutes, until golden brown. Remove from the oven and brush with 1 tablespoon butter, if desired. Serve warm.
> Store leftovers in the refrigerator; to reheat, tent with aluminum foil and bake in a preheated 350°F oven for about 10 minutes.

sourceText:
== Dough ==

Weigh your flour; or measure it by gently spooning it into a cup, then sweeping off any excess.

In the bowl of a #stand mixer{} fitted with a #paddle attachment{}, combine @milk{1%cup}, @butter{4%tablespoons} (melted), @egg{1%large} plus @egg yolk{1%large} (reserve the white for the filling), @all-purpose flour{3 3/4%cups}, @rye flour{1/2%cup}, @granulated sugar{2%tablespoons}, @instant yeast{2%teaspoons}, and @table salt{1 1/2%teaspoons}. Mix just until the dough starts to leave the sides of the bowl.

> Also known as whole rye flour, you can use rye flour blend, white rye flour, organic medium rye, or pumpernickel flour.

Cover the bowl and let the mixture rest for ~{15%minutes} for the flour to absorb the liquid; this will make the dough easier to knead.

After the rest, switch to the #dough hook{} and knead until the dough is smooth and slightly sticky, about ~{7%minutes}.

Place the dough in a lightly greased #bowl{} or 8-cup measure, cover, and let rise for ~{1%hour}, or until it's increased in volume by at least a third.

== Filling ==

Fry (or bake in a 350°F oven for ~{35%minutes}) the @bacon{1%pound} until crisp. Drain the bacon and reserve @bacon fat{2%tablespoons}.

Place the reserved fat in a large #skillet{} over medium heat. Add @onions{4%cups} (peeled and chopped) and cook for ~{15-20%minutes}, stirring occasionally, until golden brown. Remove from the heat and let cool to room temperature.

Crumble the cooled bacon and add it to the onions. Stir in @all-purpose flour{1%tablespoon} and the reserved @egg white{1%large}.

== Assembly ==

Grease a 9" x 13" #baking pan{} or two 9" round #baking pan{2}.

Deflate the risen dough and roll it into a 12" x 18" rectangle. Spread the filling over the dough, leaving 1" of one long edge uncovered. Roll up the dough toward the uncovered edge and pinch it closed to seal it.

Cut the dough into 1" slices; lay them cut side up in the prepared pan(s). Cover and let the rolls rise for about ~{1%hour}, until puffy. Toward the end of the rising time, preheat the #oven{} to 375°F.

== Bake ==

Uncover the rolls and bake for about ~{25%minutes}, until golden brown. Remove from the oven and brush with @butter{1%tablespoon}, if desired. Serve warm.

> Store leftovers in the refrigerator; to reheat, tent with aluminum foil and bake in a preheated 350°F oven for about 10 minutes.

metadata.title: Bae Italian Sandwich
metadata.description: A mouthwatering Italian ciabatta sandwich packed with savory cold cuts, creamy mozzarella, tangy vinaigrette, and crunchy vegetables.

sections.title: Vinaigrette
steps: In a small bowl, whisk together the 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 clove garlic (minced), 1 tsp dried oregano, and 1/2 tsp dried basil.
Slowly drizzle in the 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil while continuously whisking to emulsify the dressing.
Season with to taste salt and freshly ground to taste black pepper. Set aside.

sections.title: Prepare the Ciabatta Rolls
steps: Preheat a skillet or panini press over medium heat.
Lightly butter or brush 1 tbsp olive oil on the cut sides of each 2 ciabatta roll.
Toast the rolls in the skillet or panini press until golden and crispy. Remove from heat.

sections.title: Assemble the Sandwich
steps: -- Bottom Half
Drizzle a generous amount of the prepared vinaigrette over the bottom half of each 2 ciabatta roll.
Layer the 8 oz fresh mozzarella slices evenly over the vinaigrette.
-- Cold Cuts
Arrange the 4 oz prosciutto, 4 oz salami, and 4 oz capicola slices over the mozzarella, ensuring an even distribution of flavors.
> You can substitute capicola with ham, turkey, or mortadella.
-- Vegetables and Extras
Sprinkle the sliced 1/2 cup Kalamata olives and 1/2 cup banana peppers over the cold cuts.
Add the 1 medium tomato slices and 1 small red onion slices for extra freshness and crunch.
Optionally, add to taste fresh basil leaves for an aromatic touch.
-- Top Half
Drizzle a little more vinaigrette on the top half of the 2 ciabatta roll before placing it on top of the assembled ingredients.

sections.title: Press and Serve
steps: Press the sandwich firmly to help meld the flavors. If using a panini press, grill for an additional 2-3 minutes to warm the ingredients together.
Slice the sandwich into halves or quarters for easy serving.

sourceText:

Slowly drizzle in the @extra virgin olive oil{1/4%cup} while continuously whisking to emulsify the dressing.

Season with @salt{to taste} and freshly ground @black pepper{to taste}. Set aside.

== Prepare the Ciabatta Rolls ==

Preheat a #skillet{} or #panini press{} over medium heat.

Lightly butter or brush @olive oil{1%tbsp} on the cut sides of each @ciabatta roll{2}.

Toast the rolls in the #skillet{} or #panini press{} until golden and crispy. Remove from heat.

== Assemble the Sandwich ==

-- Bottom Half

Drizzle a generous amount of the prepared vinaigrette over the bottom half of each @ciabatta roll{2}.

Layer the @fresh mozzarella{8%oz} slices evenly over the vinaigrette.

-- Cold Cuts

Arrange the @prosciutto{4%oz}, @salami{4%oz}, and @capicola{4%oz} slices over the mozzarella, ensuring an even distribution of flavors.

> You can substitute capicola with ham, turkey, or mortadella.

-- Vegetables and Extras

Sprinkle the sliced @Kalamata olives{1/2%cup} and @banana peppers{1/2%cup} over the cold cuts.

metadata.title: Bae Salad
metadata.description: A bright, briny Greek-inspired salad with quick-pickled onions, ripe tomatoes, cucumber, olives, and slabs of feta.

sections.title: Prepare the Onions
steps: In a small bowl, combine 2 oz red onion, thinly sliced pole to pole, with 1/4 cup red wine vinegar. Let soak while you prepare the other ingredients, about 15 minutes. Drain onions, reserving vinegar.

sections.title: Make the Salad
steps: In a salad bowl or large mixing bowl, combine 12 oz tomatoes, cut into slices and chunks, 12 oz cucumber, peeled, quartered lengthwise, and thinly sliced crosswise, 1/4 cup Kalamata olives, pitted and halved, the drained onion, 1/2 cup extra-virgin olive oil, and about 2 tablespoons of the vinegar left over from quick-pickling the onion. Season with to taste kosher salt and 1 pinch dried oregano, toss gently to combine, then adjust to taste with more salt and vinegar, if desired.
> Pit-in olives are often better-quality than pre-pitted ones; buy pit-in olives and remove the pits yourself.

sections.title: Finish and Serve
steps: Lay 4 oz feta cheese, cut into slabs, on top. Sprinkle with the remaining pinch of 1 pinch dried oregano and drizzle with for drizzling extra-virgin olive oil. Serve, soaking up juices with bread.

sourceText:
== Prepare the Onions ==

In a small bowl, combine @red onion{2%oz}, thinly sliced pole to pole, with @red wine vinegar{1/4%cup}. Let soak while you prepare the other ingredients, about ~{15%minutes}. Drain onions, reserving vinegar.

== Make the Salad ==

In a #salad bowl{} or large mixing bowl, combine @tomatoes{12%oz}, cut into slices and chunks, @cucumber{12%oz}, peeled, quartered lengthwise, and thinly sliced crosswise, @Kalamata olives{1/4%cup}, pitted and halved, the drained onion, @extra-virgin olive oil{1/2%cup}, and about 2 tablespoons of the vinegar left over from quick-pickling the onion. Season with @kosher salt{to taste} and @dried oregano{1%pinch}, toss gently to combine, then adjust to taste with more salt and vinegar, if desired.

> Pit-in olives are often better-quality than pre-pitted ones; buy pit-in olives and remove the pits yourself.

Lay @feta cheese{4%oz}, cut into slabs, on top. Sprinkle with the remaining pinch of @dried oregano{1%pinch} and drizzle with @extra-virgin olive oil{for drizzling}. Serve, soaking up juices with bread.

metadata.title: Ban Xeo
metadata.description: Vietnamese savory crepes with shrimp, pork belly, and turmeric-infused batter

sections.title: Batter
steps: Combine 9 oz rice flour, 3 oz all-purpose wheat flour, 2.5 tsp turmeric, 3.5 cups water, 400 ml can coconut cream, and 1 tsp salt. Mix until smooth.
Stir in 1 sprig chopped scallion.

sections.title: Filling
steps: Prepare 1 pound shrimp (without heads, sized 45/50 or 60/70) and 1.5 pounds pork belly (thinly sliced).
Slice 1 onion (medium, thinly sliced).

sections.title: Cook
steps: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add a thin layer of oil.
Pour in about 0.5 cup batter and tilt to spread thinly.
Layer shrimp, pork belly slices, and onion slices on one half of the crepe.
Cover and cook for 3 minutes until the crepe is crispy and golden on the bottom.
Fold the crepe in half over the filling and slide onto a plate.
Serve with fresh herbs, lettuce leaves, and nuoc cham dipping sauce.

sourceText:
== Batter ==

== Filling ==

Cover and cook for ~{3%minutes} until the crepe is crispy and golden on the bottom.

Fold the crepe in half over the filling and slide onto a plate.

Serve with @fresh herbs{}, @lettuce leaves{}, and nuoc cham dipping sauce.

metadata.title: Banana Nut Bread
metadata.description: Classic banana nut bread with toasted pecans

steps: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F.
Cream 1 stick butter and 1 cup white sugar and 0.5 cup brown sugar together.
Mix in 3 bananas and 0.5 lemon juice.
Add 0.25 cup milk and 1 tsp vanilla.
Sift 1.75 cups flour, 1 tsp baking soda, and 1 pinch salt together. Add to wet ingredients.
Fold in 0.5 cup pecans.

metadata.title: Beef Chow Fun
metadata.description: Classic Cantonese dim sum stir-fried rice noodles with tender beef, bean sprouts, and scallions in a savory soy-oyster sauce. 干炒牛河
metadata.nutrition-note: Assumes 1.5 lb beef, reduce for smaller portions. Baking soda tenderizes the beef (velveting).
metadata.long_description: One of the great Cantonese dim sum dishes, wide rice noodles stir-fried with tender sliced beef, bean sprouts, and scallions in a savory dark soy sauce. The key is high heat and a quick hand. Use fresh thick-cut rice noodles if you can find them. Based on a recipe from Tiffy Cooks.
metadata.longDescription: One of the great Cantonese dim sum dishes, wide rice noodles stir-fried with tender sliced beef, bean sprouts, and scallions in a savory dark soy sauce. The key is high heat and a quick hand. Use fresh thick-cut rice noodles if you can find them. Based on a recipe from Tiffy Cooks.

sections.title: Marinate the Beef
steps: Cut 1½ lb beef steak(flank, sirloin, or ribeye) diagonally against the grain into thin slices.
> Freeze the meat for 10 minutes before slicing, it firms up and makes thin cuts much easier.

In a bowl, combine the beef with 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon Chinese cooking wine(Shaoxing wine), 1 tablespoon cornstarch, 1 egg white, and 1 teaspoon baking soda. Mix to coat evenly and marinate for 30 minutes marinate.
> The baking soda is a velveting technique that tenderizes the beef.

sections.title: Make the Sauce
steps: In a small bowl, mix 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon oyster sauce, 1 tablespoon dark soy sauce, 1 tablespoon sugar, 2 tablespoons water, and 1 teaspoon white pepper. Set aside.

sections.title: Stir-Fry
steps: Heat a wok or large pan over high heat. Add 2 tablespoons neutral oil and swirl to coat. Add the marinated beef and sauté for 1-2 minutes until browned on both sides.
Add ½ sliced onion(layers separated) and sauté together for 1-2 minutes.
Add 1 pack fresh rice noodles(separated into individual strands) and sauté for 3 minutes.
> If using dehydrated rice noodles, rehydrate them in warm water before cooking.
Pour in the sauce mixture. Turn heat to high and quickly sauté for 2-3 minutes until the noodles are evenly coated and slightly charred.

sections.title: Finish
steps: Add 1 cup bean sprouts and 2 green onions(cut into 2-inch pieces). Sauté for 1 minute, the sprouts should stay crisp.
Serve immediately.

sourceText:
== Marinate the Beef ==

Cut @beef steak{1½%lb}(flank, sirloin, or ribeye) diagonally against the grain into thin slices.

> Freeze the meat for 10 minutes before slicing, it firms up and makes thin cuts much easier.

In a #bowl{}, combine the beef with @soy sauce{1%tablespoon}, @Chinese cooking wine{1%tablespoon}(Shaoxing wine), @cornstarch{1%tablespoon}, @egg white{1}, and @baking soda{1%teaspoon}. Mix to coat evenly and marinate for ~marinate{30%minutes}.

> The baking soda is a velveting technique that tenderizes the beef.

== Make the Sauce ==

In a #small bowl{}, mix @soy sauce{2%tablespoons}, @oyster sauce{1%tablespoon}, @dark soy sauce{1%tablespoon}, @sugar{1%tablespoon}, @water{2%tablespoons}, and @white pepper{1%teaspoon}. Set aside.

== Stir-Fry ==

Heat a #wok{} or #large pan{} over high heat. Add @neutral oil{2%tablespoons} and swirl to coat. Add the marinated beef and sauté for ~{1-2%minutes} until browned on both sides.

Add @sliced onion{½}(layers separated) and sauté together for ~{1-2%minutes}.

Add @fresh rice noodles{1%pack}(separated into individual strands) and sauté for ~{3%minutes}.

> If using dehydrated rice noodles, rehydrate them in warm water before cooking.

Pour in the sauce mixture. Turn heat to high and quickly sauté for ~{2-3%minutes} until the noodles are evenly coated and slightly charred.

== Finish ==

Add @bean sprouts{1%cup} and @green onions{2}(cut into 2-inch pieces). Sauté for ~{1%minute}, the sprouts should stay crisp.

Serve immediately.

metadata.title: Beef Gyudon
metadata.description: Japanese beef rice bowl with thinly sliced beef and onions simmered in a savory-sweet dashi sauce.
metadata.nutrition-note: Drop rice to 1 cup/bowl to save ~135 cal per serving.
metadata.long_description: Gyudon is the Japanese comfort food classic, thinly sliced beef and onions simmered in a savory-sweet dashi sauce, served over steamed rice. Ready in 20 minutes with one pan. Use thinly shaved ribeye or chuck (find it at Japanese markets or use frozen shaved steak for cheesesteaks).
metadata.longDescription: Gyudon is the Japanese comfort food classic, thinly sliced beef and onions simmered in a savory-sweet dashi sauce, served over steamed rice. Ready in 20 minutes with one pan. Use thinly shaved ribeye or chuck (find it at Japanese markets or use frozen shaved steak for cheesesteaks).

sections.title: Make the Sauce
steps: In a large frying pan, combine 1/2 cup dashi, 2 tablespoons sake, 2 tablespoons mirin, 3 tablespoons soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon sugar. Stir to dissolve the sugar.

sections.title: Simmer
steps: Add 1 onion(thinly sliced, layers separated) to the pan. Spread evenly, then lay 1/2 lb thinly sliced beef ribeye(separated into individual slices) on top of the onions.
Cover with a lid and cook over medium heat. Once simmering, reduce heat and cook covered for 4-5 minutes simmer, skimming any scum from the surface.
Add 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger and cook uncovered for 1 minute until the sauce reduces slightly.

sections.title: Serve
steps: Divide cooked Japanese short-grain rice{2%servings}(about 1 2/3 cup per bowl) into bowls. Ladle the beef, onions, and sauce over the rice.
Top with sliced scallions, pickled red ginger(beni shoga), and shichimi togarashi(Japanese chili powder). Optional: add a 1 poached egg or raw egg yolk per bowl.

sourceText:
== Make the Sauce ==

In a #large frying pan{}, combine @dashi{1/2%cup}, @sake{2%tablespoons}, @mirin{2%tablespoons}, @soy sauce{3%tablespoons}, and @sugar{1%tablespoon}. Stir to dissolve the sugar.

== Simmer ==

Add @onion{1}(thinly sliced, layers separated) to the pan. Spread evenly, then lay @thinly sliced beef ribeye{1/2%lb}(separated into individual slices) on top of the onions.

Cover with a lid and cook over medium heat. Once simmering, reduce heat and cook covered for ~simmer{4-5%minutes}, skimming any scum from the surface.

Add @grated fresh ginger{1%teaspoon} and cook uncovered for ~{1%minute} until the sauce reduces slightly.

== Serve ==

Divide @cooked Japanese short{}-grain rice{2%servings}(about 1 2/3 cup per bowl) into bowls. Ladle the beef, onions, and sauce over the rice.

Top with @sliced scallions{}, @pickled red ginger{}(beni shoga), and @shichimi togarashi{}(Japanese chili powder). Optional: add a @poached egg{1} or raw egg yolk per bowl.

metadata.title: Big and Bubbly Focaccia
metadata.description: King Arthur's 2025 Recipe of the Year. A lofty, light focaccia with bubbly bronzed top, crisp edges, and tender airy interior. Uses a hands-off folding method for high-rise dough.

sections.title: Dough
steps: Weigh your 3 cups all-purpose flour; or measure it by gently spooning it into a cup, then sweeping off any excess. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the 3 cups all-purpose flour, 1.5 tsp table salt, 1 tsp granulated sugar, and 1 tsp instant yeast.

Add the 1.25 cups warm water and 1.5 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil and stir with a spatula, bowl scraper, dough whisk, or your hands until the mixture is thoroughly combined and homogeneous; there should be no dry patches or lumps. Cover the bowl and set it aside for 15 minutes.

sections.title: Bowl Folds
steps: Perform the first bowl fold: Use a wet hand to grab a section of dough from one side of the bowl, then lift it up and press it into the center. Repeat this motion, grabbing a new section of dough each time, until you've made a full circle around the bowl, about 8 to 12 times. Once you've circled the bowl, flip the dough over so that the smooth side is up. Cover the bowl and let the dough rest for 15 minutes.
> Note: You'll be doing this 3 more times over the next 45 minutes, each time further developing the dough's strength.
Repeat the bowl fold for a second time. Use a wet hand to prevent the dough from sticking. The dough should feel smoother and tighter. Cover the bowl and let the dough rest for 15 minutes.
Repeat the bowl fold for a third time. Cover the bowl and let the dough rest for 15 minutes.
Repeat the bowl fold for a fourth and final time; the dough should feel relatively strong.

sections.title: First Rise
steps: Cover the bowl and let the dough rise at a warm room temperature (70°F to 75°F) for 1 hour. After 1 hour, the dough should have nearly doubled in size and will be very puffy; it may even have a few bubbles on the surface.

sections.title: Prepare the Pan
steps: Once the dough has risen, spray the bottom and sides of a @9-inch square baking pan{1} with nonstick spray. Cut a 3-inch-wide strip of parchment that's about 16 inches long. Lay the strip across the center of the pan, leaving a few inches of overhang on 2 sides; press it firmly into the pan and crease the parchment where it meets the sides to help it stay in place.
> The parchment tabs will help you remove the focaccia from the pan later on.
Spray the parchment with nonstick spray, then add 1 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil and tilt the pan to spread the oil evenly across the bottom.

Use a bowl scraper or flexible spatula to gently transfer the risen dough to the center of the pan. Using your hands as paddles, swiftly but gently flip the dough over so that it's coated in oil; try to handle the dough minimally to keep it from deflating.

sections.title: Second Rise
steps: Cover the pan and let the dough rise at a warm room temperature for 1 hour to 1.5 hours, until it's marshmallowy and jiggly; the dough should nearly fill the corners of the pan and be very close to the top edge.
Toward the end of the rise, preheat the oven to 475°F with racks in the upper and lower thirds.

sections.title: Dimple and Top
steps: Once the dough has risen, lightly coat your fingers in oil. Starting at one edge, press your fingertips into the dough until they reach the bottom of the pan, creating dimples. Repeat this process, working your way from one edge to the other, spacing the dimples about 1.5 inches apart. The goal is to thoroughly dimple the dough without deflating it. If there are any large untouched areas, add additional dimples using one finger.
Drizzle the remaining 1 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil all over the surface of the dough; it's OK if it pools in some dimples. Sprinkle evenly with 1 tsp flaky sea salt.

sections.title: Bake
steps: Bake the focaccia on the lower rack for 15 minutes to 18 minutes, until brown in the highest spots and golden in the crevices. If necessary, move the pan to the top rack and broil briefly for the final 1 minute to 2 minutes, watching carefully, to achieve the desired color.

Remove the focaccia from the oven. Using the parchment tabs as handles, lift the focaccia out of the pan and transfer it to a wire rack or cutting board; remove the parchment strip. Turn off the oven and slide the focaccia back into the oven, directly on the lower rack, for 5 minutes to 7 minutes, until the sides are golden brown and crisp. Remove the focaccia from the oven once again and transfer it to a wire rack to cool completely.
> Focaccia is best enjoyed the day it's made. If storing leftovers, wrap loosely in foil, keep at room temperature, and reheat before serving.

> The temperature of your ingredients and rising environment will impact how long it takes for your dough to rise. In warmer months (or when your indoor temperature is 70°F to 75°F), the liquid should be 90°F to 100°F. In cooler months (or when your indoor temperature is around 65°F), use 100°F to 110°F liquid. The desired dough temperature after mixing should be between 82°F and 86°F.

> To make the dough ahead: Prepare through the fourth bowl fold, then cover the bowl and refrigerate for 8 to 24 hours. Proceed with the recipe, transferring the cold dough to the prepared pan. Let rise at warm room temperature for 2 to 3 hours.
> To amp up the flavor: Replace the olive oil with garlic oil and/or sprinkle the dough with up to 1/2 teaspoon herbes de Provence when you add the salt.

metadata.title: Bok Choy with Garlic Sauce
metadata.description: Restaurant-style blanched bok choy drizzled with a savory-sweet garlic sauce made from five simple ingredients. Ready in 10 minutes.
metadata.nutrition-note: The garlic sauce works on everything, try it on broccoli, gai lan, or snap peas.
metadata.long_description: Ever wonder why Chinese restaurant vegetables always taste so good? The secret is blanching in salted oil water and a killer garlic sauce. This five-ingredient sauce will taste good on everything. Only 10 minutes to make at home. Based on a recipe from Tiffy Cooks.
metadata.longDescription: Ever wonder why Chinese restaurant vegetables always taste so good? The secret is blanching in salted oil water and a killer garlic sauce. This five-ingredient sauce will taste good on everything. Only 10 minutes to make at home. Based on a recipe from Tiffy Cooks.

steps: Cut 2 lb bok choy in half lengthwise. If the stalks are large, cut in half again. Rinse well to remove any grit between the stalks.

sections.title: Blanch
steps: Bring a pot of water to a simmer. Add 1 tablespoon neutral oil and 1½ teaspoons salt to the water.
Add the bok choy and blanch for 3-4 minutes blanch, you want it soft yet still crunchy. Remove and drain well, then arrange on a serving plate.

sections.title: Make the Garlic Sauce
steps: In a small pan, combine 7 cloves minced garlic, 3 tablespoons vegetarian oyster sauce, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon sugar, and 1 tablespoon toasted sesame oil. Let it simmer for 1-2 minutes until the sugar has melted and the sauce is fragrant.

sections.title: Serve
steps: Drizzle the garlic sauce over the blanched bok choy. Serve immediately.
> This sauce works on everything, try it with broccoli, gai lan, snap peas, or asparagus.

sourceText:
Cut @bok choy{2%lb} in half lengthwise. If the stalks are large, cut in half again. Rinse well to remove any grit between the stalks.

== Blanch ==

Bring a #pot{} of water to a simmer. Add @neutral oil{1%tablespoon} and @salt{1½%teaspoons} to the water.

Add the bok choy and blanch for ~blanch{3-4%minutes}, you want it soft yet still crunchy. Remove and drain well, then arrange on a serving plate.

== Make the Garlic Sauce ==

In a #small pan{}, combine @minced garlic{7%cloves}, @vegetarian oyster sauce{3%tablespoons}, @soy sauce{2%tablespoons}, @sugar{1%tablespoon}, and @toasted sesame oil{1%tablespoon}. Let it simmer for ~{1-2%minutes} until the sugar has melted and the sauce is fragrant.

== Serve ==

Drizzle the garlic sauce over the blanched bok choy. Serve immediately.

> This sauce works on everything, try it with broccoli, gai lan, snap peas, or asparagus.

metadata.title: Bombay Potatoes
metadata.description: Crispy fried potatoes in a spiced onion-tomato masala, a classic Indian side dish.

sections.title: Boil Potatoes
steps: Wash the 500 grams potatoes well under running water. If you want to keep the skin on, brush the potatoes well and rinse, else peel the potatoes. If you are using large potatoes, dice them to 1½ inch sizes. If using whole baby potatoes, poke them with a fork or pick.
Add to a pot with 3 cups water, 1 teaspoon salt and a pinch turmeric (optional). Optionally you may add a pinch garam masala and a little a pinch red chilli powder too to flavor up your aloo.

Bring the water to a rolling boil and reduce the heat to medium. Boil until the potatoes are fork tender but not mushy. Turn off and remove the potatoes from water. Cool completely. While the potatoes boil, chop the 1 cup onions, 3/4 cup tomatoes, 1 teaspoon ginger, 1 teaspoon garlic and 1 green chilli.

> It is very important to add salt to the pot of water while boiling the potatoes else they taste bland. To the pot, if you want you can also add turmeric, red chilli powder and garam masala for heat and flavor. Note: Turmeric stains your pot.

sections.title: Make Bombay Potatoes
steps: Pour 2 tablespoons oil into a hot pan. When the oil is hot enough, add the potatoes and fry them until golden and crisp. Remove them to a plate.
Pour another 1 tablespoon oil to the pan and add 1/4 teaspoon mustard seeds and 1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds. When the seeds begin to splutter, stir in the 1 sprig curry leaves.
Add the 1 cup onions, 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1 green chilli. Saute on a medium high heat until they turn golden.

Lower the heat. Add the 1 teaspoon ginger and 1 teaspoon garlic and saute for 1 minute. Stir in all the ground spices: 1/2 teaspoon Kashmiri red chilli powder, a pinch turmeric, 1/2 teaspoon garam masala, 1/2 teaspoon cumin powder, 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder and 1/4 teaspoon fennel powder.
Add the 3/4 cup tomatoes and saute until they turn mushy and soft. Reduce the heat and saute the onion tomato masala for a few more minutes until aromatic.
Transfer the fried potatoes and pour 1/2 cup hot water. Mix well and bring the potatoes to the center of the pan. Taste test and adjust the salt. Cover them with the onion tomato masala.
Cover and cook on a low heat for 5 minutes to 6 minutes so the potatoes absorb the flavors. Make sure you don't overcook the potatoes as they can easily turn mushy.
Turn off the heat and garnish with a handful coriander leaves. Serve Bombay potatoes with rice, roti or chapati. You can also mash them slightly and fill your sandwiches and wraps.
> To make yellow Bombay Potatoes, boil the potatoes in turmeric and salt. Leave out the red chilli powder, coriander and cumin powder. Double the green chilies for heat.
> To make red Bombay potatoes, use red chilli powder and cut down the other spices.
