metadata.title: Temaki Sushi Hand Rolls
metadata.description: Japanese hand-rolled temaki sushi with seasoned rice, nori, and an assortment of fish and vegetable fillings, a fun party format.

sections.title: Sushi Rice
steps: > Sushi rice takes at least 90 minutes to prepare. Use Japanese short-grain white rice only; other varieties will cause the rolls to fall apart.
Cook Japanese short-grain white rice{3%rice cooker cups} (yields about 6 2/3 cups cooked).
Season the cooked rice with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt to make sushi rice (sumeshi). Fan the rice while mixing to cool it to room temperature.
Transfer the seasoned rice to a hangiri or large shallow bowl. Cover with a damp cloth to prevent drying out.

sections.title: Vegetable Fillings
steps: Remove the stems from shiso leaves. Cut off the root ends of kaiware daikon radish sprouts and rinse thoroughly under water.

Peel Japanese or Persian cucumbers to create a striped pattern. Cut off both ends and halve lengthwise. Remove the seeds with a knife or spoon, then cut into 3-inch lengths and slice lengthwise into thin sticks.
Cut takuan pickled daikon radish into 3-inch lengths, then into slabs and thin sticks.

sections.title: Sashimi Fillings
steps: > Use only sashimi-grade fish from a trusted fishmonger. Ask them to cut the fish into long sticks for temaki if available.
Remove sashimi-grade fish of your choice from the refrigerator. Recommended fish: salmon, tuna (maguro), yellowtail (hamachi), scallop (hotate), sweet shrimp (amaebi).
Pat dry with a paper towel to remove excess moisture. If the sashimi block is long, cut it about 3 inches in length. Cut the blocks lengthwise into slabs, then long sticks.
> For 4 people, a typical order: 3/4 lb salmon, 1/3 lb chutoro, 2 packages amaebi, 2 packages hotate, 1/4 lb white fish, 1 box uni, 2 oz ikura.

sections.title: Prepare the Nori
steps: Right before eating, cut 10 sheets nori seaweed sheets in half for 20 cone-shaped rolls, or in quarters for 40 taco-style rolls. Keep the nori in the bag to prevent staleness.

sections.title: Roll the Temaki
steps: Place a half sheet of nori on the palm of your non-dominant hand, shiny side down. Start with dry hands to keep the nori crispy.
Add a thin layer of sushi rice (about 2 tbsp sushi rice) to the left third of the nori sheet (if right-handed) and spread evenly.
Place fillings vertically along the middle of the rice: cucumber sticks, takuan, 1-2 types of sashimi, and radish sprouts.
Fold the bottom left corner up to the middle of the top edge of the nori to form a triangle, then continue rolling into a cone shape.
Press a small piece of rice on the tip of the nori to use as glue and seal the cone.
> For quarter-sheet taco style: put rice in the center, add fillings on top, and fold up the sides like a taco.

sections.title: Serve
steps: Serve with pickled sushi ginger, wasabi, and soy sauce or sashimi soy sauce.
> For fatty fish like salmon belly and chutoro, sear with a kitchen butane torch at the table right before eating for enhanced flavor.
> Sashimi-grade fish must be eaten within 24 hours. Keep leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

metadata.title: Texas Roadhouse Rolls
metadata.description: Soft, buttery dinner rolls with cinnamon honey butter

steps: -- Roadhouse Rolls (65-68% hydration)
In a medium pot, over medium-high heat, add the 465 g whole milk and bring it to a boil. Cut the heat, pour into a bowl and cool over an ice bath.
Once cooled, add 120 g warm water, heat to 95°F, add 12 g instant yeast, dissolve and reserve.
In a stand mixer bowl, add the 1050 g all-purpose flour, 110 g granulated sugar, 12 g fine sea salt, and 1/8 tsp diastatic malt powder. The malt powder is optional but helps with color and flavor.

Using the hook attachment, add 50 g unsalted butter melted and slightly cooled in a stream and mix. Once incorporated, add the milk mixture and 2 whole eggs. Mix until the dough does not stick to the sides of the bowl.
Take the dough out, form a ball, place into a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise for 1-1.5 hours at room temperature until doubled.
Remove plastic wrap and punch the dough. Put on a floured surface, cut into 40 even pieces, and shape into balls.
Place balls on a lined sheet tray, cover with plastic wrap, and proof for 20 minutes.
Preheat oven to 375°F.
Remove wrap, spray with water, and bake for 15-18 minutes.
Brush each roll with 3 tbsp melted butter and sprinkle with smoked flaky salt.
-- Charred Cinnamon Honey Butter
Lightly char 3 cinnamon sticks and break into tiny pieces by pounding.

Place 161 g salted butter softened, 2 g fine sea salt, 1/8 tsp black pepper finely ground, 2 tsp cinnamon powder, 1/4 tsp fresh grated nutmeg, and the beans from 1 vanilla bean scraped in a mixing bowl and whisk until smooth.
Add 29 g powdered sugar and whisk vigorously to incorporate air.
Add 20 g wildflower honey and 20 g buckwheat honey and incorporate.
Serve rolls warm with cinnamon honey butter.

metadata.title: Thai Basil Pork Belly (Krapow Moo Krob)
metadata.description: Thai street-food stir-fry of crispy pork belly with garlic, chili, fish sauce, and holy basil over rice.

sections.title: Sauce
steps: Mix 1.5 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tbsp light soy sauce, 0.5 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp white sugar, and 3 tbsp water in a small bowl. Set aside.

sections.title: Stir-Fry
steps: Pound 3 cloves garlic and 4 red chilies(adjust to taste) with a mortar and pestle.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or skillet over medium heat. Sauté the chili and garlic paste until fragrant and golden.
Add the sauce mix and allow the sauces to cook and blend together for a brief moment.
Add 1.33 cups fried pork belly(sliced) and 1 handful holy basil. Toss to mix until the basil is slightly wilted and the pork belly is warm. Serve immediately.

metadata.title: Thanksgiving Turkey
metadata.description: Thanksgiving Turkey

ingredients.name: kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps: Preheat oven to 450°F.

Roughly chop 3 large onions, peel and roughly chop 3 large carrots, and roughly chop 4 stalks celery. Spread the vegetables in the bottom of a large roasting pan. Scatter 12 thyme sprigs over the vegetables.
Butterfly the 12 to 14 lb whole turkey by removing the backbone. Press the turkey flat and place on top of the vegetables, skin side up.
Rub 2 tbsp vegetable oil over the turkey skin. Season generously with kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Pour 1.5 quarts chicken or turkey broth into the bottom of the roasting pan. Add 2 bay leaves.
Roast for 80 minutes until the breast registers 150°F and the thighs register 165°F on an instant-read thermometer.
Remove from oven and let rest for 20 minutes before carving.
Use the drippings and vegetables in the pan to make gravy, straining and thickening as desired.

metadata.title: The Best Mashed Potatoes
metadata.description: Rich, creamy homemade mashed potatoes. Easy to make and always a crowd favorite.

steps: Peel the 5 pounds potatoes (half Yukon Gold, half Russet) or leave the skins on.
Cut into evenly-sized chunks about 1 inch thick and transfer to a large stockpot filled with cold water.

sections.title: Boil
steps: Ensure water covers the 5 pounds potatoes by about 1 inch.
Stir in 2 cloves garlic, minced, and 1 tablespoon fine sea salt.
Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to medium-high and cook for 10-12 minutes until a knife pierces easily.
Drain the water carefully.

sections.title: Butter Mixture
steps: While potatoes boil, heat 6 tablespoons butter, 1 cup whole milk, and 2 teaspoons fine sea salt in a small saucepan or microwave until butter melts.
> Do not boil the milk.
Set aside.

sections.title: Pan-Dry
steps: After draining, return 5 pounds potatoes to the hot stockpot on the burner.
Reduce heat to low and gently shake the pot for about 1 minute to evaporate excess moisture.
Remove from heat.

sections.title: Mash
steps: Use a potato masher to mash the 5 pounds potatoes to your desired consistency.

sections.title: Mix
steps: Pour half the melted butter mixture over the 5 pounds potatoes and gently fold with a wooden spoon or spatula.
Repeat with the remaining butter mixture, then fold in 4 ounces cream cheese at room temperature.
> Avoid over-mixing to keep potatoes fluffy.
Add more warm whole milk if needed to reach your desired consistency.

sections.title: Season and Serve
steps: Taste and adjust seasoning with extra fine sea salt as needed.
Serve warm with gravy or your favorite toppings.

sourceText:
Peel the @potatoes{5%pounds} (half Yukon Gold, half Russet) or leave the skins on.

Cut into evenly-sized chunks about 1 inch thick and transfer to a large #stockpot{} filled with cold water.

== Boil ==

Ensure water covers the @potatoes{5%pounds} by about 1 inch.

Stir in @garlic{2%cloves}, minced, and @fine sea salt{1%tablespoon}.

Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to medium-high and cook for ~{10-12%minutes} until a knife pierces easily.

Drain the water carefully.

== Butter Mixture ==

While potatoes boil, heat @butter{6%tablespoons}, @whole milk{1%cup}, and @fine sea salt{2%teaspoons} in a small #saucepan{} or microwave until butter melts.

> Do not boil the milk.

Set aside.

== Pan-Dry ==

After draining, return @potatoes{5%pounds} to the hot #stockpot{} on the burner.

Reduce heat to low and gently shake the pot for about ~{1%minute} to evaporate excess moisture.

Remove from heat.

== Mash ==

Use a #potato masher{} to mash the @potatoes{5%pounds} to your desired consistency.

== Mix ==

Pour half the melted butter mixture over the @potatoes{5%pounds} and gently fold with a #wooden spoon{} or spatula.

Repeat with the remaining butter mixture, then fold in @cream cheese{4%ounces} at room temperature.

> Avoid over-mixing to keep potatoes fluffy.

Add more warm @whole milk{} if needed to reach your desired consistency.

== Season and Serve ==

Taste and adjust seasoning with extra @fine sea salt{} as needed.

Serve warm with gravy or your favorite toppings.

metadata.title: The Ultimate Potato Soup
metadata.description: The Ultimate Potato Soup
metadata.nutrition-note: Bacon, butter, cream, and cheddar toppings aren't included.
metadata.author: Sam Merritt
metadata.long_description: An easy and delicious creamy potato soup made in just one pot. Loaded with bacon and creamy potato goodness.
metadata.longDescription: An easy and delicious creamy potato soup made in just one pot. Loaded with bacon and creamy potato goodness.

sections.title: Cook Bacon
steps: Place 6 strips bacon(cut into small pieces) in a dutch oven or soup pot over medium heat and cook until bacon is crisp and browned.
Remove bacon pieces and set aside, leaving the fat in the pot.

sections.title: Build the Base
steps: Add 3 tablespoons butter and 1 yellow onion(chopped, about 1.5 cups) and cook over medium heat until onions are tender (3-5 minutes onions).
Add 3 cloves garlic(minced) and cook until fragrant (30 seconds garlic).
Sprinkle 1/3 cup all-purpose flour over the ingredients in the pot and stir until smooth, using a whisk if needed.

sections.title: Simmer
steps: Add 2.5 lbs gold potatoes(peeled and diced into pieces no larger than 1 inch) to the pot along with 4 cups chicken broth, 2 cups milk, 2/3 cup heavy cream, 1.5 teaspoons salt, 1 teaspoon ground pepper, and 1/4 teaspoon ancho chili powder. Stir well.
Bring to a boil and cook until potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork (10 minutes potatoes).

sections.title: Puree
steps: Reduce heat to simmer. Remove approximately half of the soup to a blender (be careful, it will be hot) and puree until smooth. Alternatively, use an immersion blender.
> I prefer potato soup with chunks of potato, puree just half. For completely creamy soup, puree all of it in batches.
Return the pureed soup to the pot and add 2/3 cup sour cream and the reserved bacon pieces. Stir well.
Allow soup to simmer for 15 minutes final simmer before serving.

sections.title: Serve
steps: Top with shredded cheddar cheese, chives, sour cream, and bacon.

sourceText:
== Cook Bacon ==

Place @bacon{6%strips}(cut into small pieces) in a #dutch oven{} or soup pot over medium heat and cook until bacon is crisp and browned.

Remove bacon pieces and set aside, leaving the fat in the pot.

== Build the Base ==

Add @butter{3%tablespoons} and @yellow onion{1}(chopped, about 1.5 cups) and cook over medium heat until onions are tender (~onions{3-5%minutes}).

Add @garlic{3%cloves}(minced) and cook until fragrant (~garlic{30%seconds}).

Sprinkle @all-purpose flour{1/3%cup} over the ingredients in the pot and stir until smooth, using a #whisk{} if needed.

== Simmer ==

Add @gold potatoes{2.5%lbs}(peeled and diced into pieces no larger than 1 inch) to the pot along with @chicken broth{4%cups}, @milk{2%cups}, @heavy cream{2/3%cup}, @salt{1.5%teaspoons}, @ground pepper{1%teaspoon}, and @ancho chili powder{1/4%teaspoon}. Stir well.

Bring to a boil and cook until potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork (~potatoes{10%minutes}).

== Puree ==

Reduce heat to simmer. Remove approximately half of the soup to a #blender{} (be careful, it will be hot) and puree until smooth. Alternatively, use an #immersion blender{}.

> I prefer potato soup with chunks of potato, puree just half. For completely creamy soup, puree all of it in batches.

Return the pureed soup to the pot and add @sour cream{2/3%cup} and the reserved bacon pieces. Stir well.

Allow soup to simmer for ~final simmer{15%minutes} before serving.

== Serve ==

Top with @shredded cheddar cheese{}, @chives{}, @sour cream{}, and @bacon{}.

metadata.title: Thickened Teriyaki Sauce
metadata.description: Teriyaki Sauce

steps: > Ready in 10 minutes, no junk ingredients, and crazy delicious. You'll never use store-bought again!
Combine 1/2 cup soy sauce, 1/4 cup brown sugar, minced 3 cloves garlic, grated 1 tbsp fresh ginger, 2 tbsp honey, and 1/4 cup mirin in a saucepan.
Heat over medium heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
In a small bowl, whisk 1 tbsp cornstarch and 2 tbsp water together to make a slurry. Add to the saucepan.
> To use as a marinade, simply omit the cornstarch, let the sauce cool completely, and you've got the perfect teriyaki marinade!
Continue cooking and stirring for 3 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Remove from heat and let cool. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

metadata.title: Tomato Meat Sauce
metadata.description: A rich and flavorful meat sauce perfect for pasta dishes, lasagna, or any recipe calling for a hearty tomato-based sauce.

steps: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the 1 pound ground beef (80/20 lean-to-fat ratio) and 1/2 pound ground pork, breaking it up with a wooden spoon as it cooks. Cook until browned, 6 minutes.
Add the 1 large onion, finely chopped, 3 carrots, finely grated, and 3 stalks celery, finely chopped to the meat. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables have softened.
Add the 5 cloves garlic, minced, and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the 1/2 cup red wine and let it simmer for 3 minutes, until mostly evaporated.
Add the 2 28 oz cans crushed tomatoes, 1 6 oz can tomato paste, 2 tbsp dried basil, 2 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp sugar, and 2 bay leaves. Stir well to combine.
Bring the sauce to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Simmer, partially covered, for at least 60 minutes (or up to 180 minutes for deeper flavor), stirring occasionally.
> For extra depth of flavor, add a Parmesan rind while simmering or stir in a pat of butter at the end. The longer you let the sauce simmer, the more the flavors will develop and meld together.
Taste and adjust seasoning with to taste salt and to taste black pepper as needed.
Remove bay leaves before serving. Garnish with 1/4 cup fresh basil, chopped.
> This sauce can be served immediately over pasta, or cooled and stored in the refrigerator for up to 4 days or in the freezer for up to 3 months.

metadata.title: Tropical Smoothie Bowl
metadata.description: Tropical high-protein granola smoothie bowl with fresh fruit toppings.

sections.title: Smoothie Base
steps: In a blender, combine the 1 large frozen banana, 0.5 cup frozen mango chunks, 0.5 cup frozen pineapple chunks, 1 scoop vanilla protein powder, 1 cup unsweetened coconut milk, 0.25 cup non-dairy yogurt, 1 tbsp honey, and 1 tsp chia seeds.
> Non-dairy yogurt is optional for extra creaminess and protein. Adjust honey to taste. Chia seeds are optional for added fiber and omega-3s.
Blend on high until smooth and creamy. If too thick, add more 1 tbsp coconut milk at a time until desired consistency.
Transfer the blended smoothie into a bowl.

sections.title: Toppings
steps: Sprinkle 0.25 cup granola evenly over the smoothie base.
> Choose your favorite high-protein granola.
Arrange 0.5 cup fresh tropical fruit and 0.5 banana banana slices decoratively around the bowl.
> Use kiwi slices, pineapple chunks, or mango slices.
Add 1 tbsp coconut flakes and 1 tbsp pumpkin seeds for crunch.
> Toast the coconut flakes for extra flavor. Hemp seeds work too.
Drizzle with 1 tsp honey if desired.

sections.title: Serve
steps: Enjoy immediately for the best texture and flavor.
> Smoothie bowls are best fresh. You can prepare the smoothie base in advance and refrigerate up to 24 hours, then add toppings just before serving.

metadata.title: Udon Beef Noodle Soup
metadata.description: Thinly shaved beef cooked with onions in a sweet-savory dashi broth, served over chewy udon noodles, classic Japanese comfort food.

sections.title: Dashi
steps: Combine 2 quarts cold water and 20 gram kombu (about 2 four-inch squares) in a medium saucepan and place over medium heat.
As soon as the water boils, remove from heat and add 20 gram katsuobushi (about 2 cups loosely packed dried bonito flakes), pushing it gently into the water to submerge. Do not stir vigorously.
Steep for 5 minutes to 10 minutes.
Strain and discard the kombu and katsuobushi, and return the dashi to the saucepan. Keep warm but do not let it boil.
> You can use instant dashi powder, such as Hondashi, in place of homemade dashi.

sections.title: Beef
steps: Combine 1 pound thinly shaved beef, 1 yellow onion (small, thinly sliced), 1 bunch scallion whites (white parts cut into 2-inch segments and halved lengthwise), 1 tbsp granulated sugar, 0.25 cup sake, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp mirin, and 1 cup finished dashi in a large skillet or saute pan.

Bring to a simmer over high heat, stirring. Continue cooking over high heat, stirring frequently, until the beef and onions are tender and the mixture is still moist but not soupy, 10 minutes to 15 minutes.

> You can find thinly shaved beef intended for shabu-shabu or sukiyaki at most Asian supermarkets. Alternatively, use high-quality shaved beef for cheesesteaks, or regular ground beef for different but delicious results.

sections.title: Noodles
steps: As the beef cooks, bring a pot of unsalted water to a boil, udon noodles are typically made with plenty of salt in the dough.
Cook 1 pound udon noodles (fresh or frozen) according to package directions.

sections.title: Serve
steps: Add 2 tbsp soy sauce plus more as needed and 3 tbsp mirin plus more as needed to the reserved dashi and stir. Taste and adjust seasoning to taste with more soy sauce or mirin. The broth should have a balanced savory-sweet flavor.

Divide the cooked noodles across 4 large serving bowls. Ladle the broth on top of the noodles. Divide the beef and onion mixture evenly across the noodles, including any liquid in the pan. Top each bowl with scallion greens (light green parts, thinly sliced at a sharp angle).
Serve immediately with shichimi togarashi or nanami togarashi to taste.

> To make gyudon (Japanese beef and rice bowls), omit the noodles and broth (making only enough dashi to cook the beef) and serve the cooked beef mixture on top of bowls of steamed white rice. Garnish with beni shoga (pickled red ginger) and a poached or fried egg.

sourceText:

> You can find thinly shaved beef intended for shabu-shabu or sukiyaki at most Asian supermarkets. Alternatively, use high-quality shaved beef for cheesesteaks, or regular ground beef for different but delicious results.

== Noodles ==

As the beef cooks, bring a pot of unsalted water to a boil, udon noodles are typically made with plenty of salt in the dough.

== Serve ==

Add @soy sauce{2%tbsp} plus more as needed and @mirin{3%tbsp} plus more as needed to the reserved dashi and stir. Taste and adjust seasoning to taste with more soy sauce or mirin. The broth should have a balanced savory-sweet flavor.

metadata.title: Vegetable Mushroom and Spinach Omelette
metadata.description: A veggie-packed omelette with mushrooms, spinach, bell pepper, and optional feta cheese.

sections.title: Prepare the Vegetables
steps: Rinse all vegetables thoroughly. Slice the 1/2 cup mushrooms, dice the 1/2 cup bell pepper and 1/4 cup tomatoes, and finely chop the 1/4 cup onion and 1 clove garlic.
If using large spinach leaves, roughly chop the 1 cup fresh spinach for easier cooking.

sections.title: Beat the Eggs
steps: In a mixing bowl, crack the 3 large eggs and add the 2 large egg whites if using.
Use a whisk or fork to beat the eggs until the mixture is smooth and slightly frothy.
Add a pinch of to taste salt, to taste black pepper, and 1/4 tsp paprika or your preferred seasoning. Mix well.

sections.title: Saut the Vegetables
steps: Place the non-stick skillet over medium heat and add the 1 tsp olive oil.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet. Saut for 2-3 minutes until the onions become translucent and fragrant.
Add the sliced mushrooms and diced bell peppers. Cook for 4-5 minutes until the vegetables are tender and the mushrooms have released their moisture.
Stir in the fresh spinach and diced tomatoes if using. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the spinach wilts.
Taste and adjust seasoning with more salt and pepper if needed. Remove the sauted vegetables from the skillet and set aside.

sections.title: Cook the Omelette
steps: Lightly reheat the skillet over medium heat and add a tiny bit more olive oil if necessary to prevent sticking.
Pour the beaten eggs evenly into the skillet, tilting the pan to spread them out evenly.
Allow the eggs to cook undisturbed for 1-2 minutes until the edges start to set while the center remains slightly runny.
Evenly distribute the sauted vegetables over one half of the omelette. Sprinkle with 2 tbsp feta cheese if desired.
Carefully lift the opposite side of the omelette with a spatula and fold it over the filling to create a half-moon shape.
Let the omelette cook for another 1-2 minutes to ensure the cheese melts and the eggs are fully set. You can cover the skillet with a lid for a minute to help with melting.

sections.title: Serve
steps: Gently slide the omelette onto a plate.
Sprinkle 1 tbsp fresh herbs like parsley or chives on top for added flavor and color.
> Serve with a side of whole-grain toast, avocado slices, or a fresh fruit salad for a complete meal.

metadata.title: Vinaigrette Dressing
metadata.description: A 3:1 ratio Italian vinaigrette with herbs and Parmigiano-Reggiano, perfect for delicate greens, grilled vegetables, or crusty bread.

steps: In a bowl, whisk together 1/4 cup red wine vinegar, 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice, minced 2 clove garlic, 1 tsp dijon mustard, 1/2 tsp honey, 1 1/2 tsp dried oregano, freshly grated 3 tbsp parmigiano-reggiano cheese, finely chopped 3 tbsp fresh basil, and 1/8 tsp red pepper flakes.
Gradually stream in the 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil while whisking constantly to create an emulsion.
Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste.
Transfer to a jar with a tight-fitting lid and shake vigorously to ensure all ingredients are well combined.
Refrigerate for at least 15 minutes before serving to allow flavors to meld.

> Remember to shake the dressing well before each use, as the ingredients may separate when stored. This vinaigrette will keep in the refrigerator for up to a week, bring to room temperature and shake well before using.

metadata.title: Vinegared Eggs
metadata.description: Baida vindaloo, a vinegary, hard-boiled egg dish that is almost like a pickle, tart, hot, garlicky and just very slightly sweet. Perfect for picnics.

sections.title: Spice Paste
steps: Mash or grate the 4 garlic cloves to a pulp, or put through a garlic press.

Combine the 4 cloves garlic, 1 inch piece fresh ginger (peeled and very finely grated), 0.25 tsp Kashmiri chilli powder, 2 tsp paprika, 1.5 tsp ground cumin, 1.25 tsp salt, 1.5 tbsp brown sugar and the 2 tbsp mild white vinegar in a cup or small bowl. Mix well.
> Use the mildest vinegar you can find. You may use 6 to 8 eggs without altering any other ingredients. Adjust the Kashmiri chilli powder between ⅛ and ½ teaspoon to taste.

sections.title: Cook the Sauce
steps: Heat the 3 tbsp vegetable oil in a medium-sized frying pan over a medium heat. When hot, put in the 1 inch piece cinnamon stick. Let it sizzle for a few seconds.
Put in all the 225 gram onions (peeled and finely chopped). Stir and fry for about 5 minutes or until the onions have softened.
Put in the paste from the cup as well as the 0.5 tsp garam masala. Stir and fry for 2 minutes.

sections.title: Simmer the Eggs
steps: Pour in the 125 ml mild white vinegar as well as the 175 ml water. Stir to mix and bring to a simmer.

Put all the 8 hard-boiled eggs (peeled and halved) into the frying pan in a single layer, cut sides up. Spoon the sauce over them. Cook over a medium heat for about 5 minutes or until the sauce has thickened. Spoon the sauce frequently over the eggs as you do so.
> Serve with rice or an Indian bread.

sourceText:
== Spice Paste ==

> Use the mildest vinegar you can find. You may use 6 to 8 eggs without altering any other ingredients. Adjust the Kashmiri chilli powder between ⅛ and ½ teaspoon to taste.

== Cook the Sauce ==

Heat the @vegetable oil{3%tbsp} in a medium-sized #frying pan{} over a medium heat. When hot, put in the @cinnamon stick{1%inch piece}. Let it sizzle for a few seconds.

Put in all the @onions{225%gram} (peeled and finely chopped). Stir and fry for about ~{5%minutes} or until the onions have softened.

Put in the paste from the cup as well as the @garam masala{0.5%tsp}. Stir and fry for ~{2%minutes}.

== Simmer the Eggs ==

Pour in the @mild white vinegar{125%ml} as well as the @water{175%ml}. Stir to mix and bring to a simmer.

Put all the @hard-boiled eggs{8} (peeled and halved) into the frying pan in a single layer, cut sides up. Spoon the sauce over them. Cook over a medium heat for about ~{5%minutes} or until the sauce has thickened. Spoon the sauce frequently over the eggs as you do so.

> Serve with rice or an Indian bread.

metadata.title: White Chili With Chicken
metadata.description: A flavorful and hearty white chili recipe featuring chicken and a variety of chiles

steps: Soak 1 lb small white beans (Navy, Great Northern, or cannellini) in 1 gallon (4 quarts) 4 quarts water and 0.25 cup kosher salt. Let rest at room temperature for 8 hours up to 24 hours. Drain and rinse beans.

Adjust broiler rack to 8 inches below broiler element and preheat to high. Place 2 fresh poblano chiles, 4 Anaheim chiles or 4 Hatch chiles, jalapeño chiles{2}, split 1 medium onion, and 8 cloves garlic on a foil-lined rimmed baking sheet. Toss with 1 tbsp vegetable oil and season with salt. Broil, turning occasionally, until blackened and wrinkled, 17 minutes.

Transfer broiled chiles and vegetables to a large bowl with 1 quart low-sodium chicken stock. Peel chiles in the stock, discarding skins and seeds. Purée chile flesh, onion, garlic, and  pickled jalapeño pepper{1} in a blender.

Heat remaining 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a Dutch oven. Add 1 tbsp ground cumin and 1 tsp ground coriander seeds, cooking until fragrant. Strain the chicken stock into the pot, pressing on skins and seeds.
Add the soaked beans and 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves to the pot, adding water as necessary to submerge. Cook until chicken reaches 150°F (66°C), about 15 minutes.

Transfer chicken to a bowl. Continue simmering broth and beans until beans are tender, about 1 hour. Blend 1 1/2 cups of beans and liquid until smooth, then stir back into pot. Shred chicken and add back to the stew.
Stir in half of 0.5 lb pepper Jack cheese, 2 tbsp pickling liquid, 2 tbsp lime juice, and half of 0.5 cup fresh cilantro leaves. Season with salt to taste.
Serve immediately with extra shredded 0.5 cup pepper Jack cheese, 4 lime wedges, 0.25 cup fresh cilantro leaves, and sliced 4 scallions.

metadata.title: Whole Green Lentils with Garlic & Onion
metadata.description: A simple and flavourful method of cooking whole green lentils with garlic and onion. Serve with rice, vindaloo, or Gujarati-style green beans.

sections.title: Cook the Aromatics
steps: Heat the 4 tbsp vegetable oil in a heavy pot over a medium flame. When hot, put in the 0.5 tsp cumin seeds. A few seconds later, put in the 4 garlic cloves, peeled and finely chopped. Stir and fry until the garlic pieces turn golden.
Now put in the 75 g onion, peeled and chopped. Stir and fry until the onion pieces begin to turn brown at the edges.

sections.title: Simmer the Lentils
steps: Put in the 200 g whole green lentils, picked over, washed and drained, and the 720 ml water. Bring to the boil. Cover, reduce the heat to low and simmer for about 1 hour or until the lentils are tender.

sections.title: Season and Finish
steps: Add the 1 tsp salt and 0.25 tsp cayenne pepper. Stir to mix and simmer gently for another 5 minutes.
> Adjust the cayenne pepper to taste -- use as little as 1/8 teaspoon for mild heat or up to 1/4 teaspoon for a noticeable kick.

Heat the @vegetable oil{4%tbsp} in a #heavy pot{} over a medium flame. When hot, put in the @cumin seeds{0.5%tsp}. A few seconds later, put in the @garlic cloves{4}, peeled and finely chopped. Stir and fry until the garlic pieces turn golden.

Now put in the @onion{75%g}, peeled and chopped. Stir and fry until the onion pieces begin to turn brown at the edges.

== Simmer the Lentils ==

Put in the @whole green lentils{200%g}, picked over, washed and drained, and the @water{720%ml}. Bring to the boil. Cover, reduce the heat to low and simmer for about ~{1%hour} or until the lentils are tender.

== Season and Finish ==

Add the @salt{1%tsp} and @cayenne pepper{0.25%tsp}. Stir to mix and simmer gently for another ~{5%minutes}.

> Adjust the cayenne pepper to taste -- use as little as 1/8 teaspoon for mild heat or up to 1/4 teaspoon for a noticeable kick.

metadata.title: Whole Green Lentils with Spinach and Ginger
metadata.description: A very nourishing dish of whole green lentils simmered with spinach, ginger, and fresh coriander.

sections.title: Cook the Lentils
steps: Put the 200 g whole green lentils and the 720 ml water into a heavy pot and bring to the boil. Cover, reduce the heat to low and simmer gently for 45-60 minutes.

sections.title: Prepare the Spinach
steps: Over a medium flame, heat the 6 tbsp vegetable oil in a pot large enough to hold the spinach. When hot, put in the 1-2 fresh hot green chillies, finely sliced, and the 1 tsp fresh ginger, peeled and very finely grated. Stir and fry for 10 seconds.
Add the 8 tbsp fresh green coriander, chopped, and the 560 g fresh spinach, trimmed, washed and chopped. Stir and cook until the spinach has wilted.

sections.title: Combine and Simmer
steps: Now put in the cooked lentils and the 2 tsp salt, or to taste. Stir to mix and bring to a simmer. Cover and cook very gently for 10-15 minutes.

sections.title: Finish
steps: Add the to taste black pepper and 2 tbsp lemon juice, or more to taste. Stir to mix, then cook, uncovered, for another 5 minutes. Check the seasonings and serve.
> This very nourishing dish goes well with Beef baked with yogurt and black pepper and Lamb dopiaza.

Put the @whole green lentils{200%g} and the @water{720%ml} into a #heavy pot{} and bring to the boil. Cover, reduce the heat to low and simmer gently for ~{45-60%minutes}.

metadata.title: Yeast-Raised Doughnuts
metadata.description: Light, airy yeast-raised doughnuts fried until golden, the King Arthur classic, perfect for glazing or filling.

sections.title: Make the Dough
steps: In a large bowl or the bowl of a stand mixer, whisk together 3 cups all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tsp instant yeast, and 1/4 tsp nutmeg.
In a small bowl, whisk together 1 large egg, 1 cup milk, 2 tbsp unsalted butter (melted), and 1/2 tsp vanilla extract. Add the wet ingredients all at once to the dry ingredients.
Mix and knead to make a soft dough. Cover and let rest for 5 minutes resting.

sections.title: Knead and Rise
steps: Knead the dough for 6-8 minutes kneading until smooth and soft.
Place the dough in a lightly greased large bowl. Turn to coat the top with oil. Cover and let rise for 1 1/2-2 hours first rise until doubled in bulk.

sections.title: Shape the Doughnuts
steps: Deflate the dough and turn it out onto a lightly floured surface. Gently roll it 1/4 inch thick.
Cut out doughnuts with a 2 1/2 to 3 inch round cutter.
> Re-roll scraps once to cut additional doughnuts. Over-working the scraps makes tough doughnuts.
Cover loosely with greased plastic wrap and let rise for 30-60 minutes second rise until doubled.

sections.title: Fry
steps: Heat 6 cups peanut oil or vegetable shortening in a heavy frying pan or skillet to 350°F.
Carefully place the doughnuts in the oil, 2 or 3 at a time. Fry until golden brown, then turn over and cook the second side. Each side should take about 1 minute frying per side.
Remove from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on absorbent paper.

sections.title: Finish
steps: Fill or frost doughnuts as desired. For a simple finish, dredge in a mixture of granulated sugar and ground cinnamon while still warm, or dip in a glaze made from powdered sugar and milk.

sourceText:

In a small bowl, whisk together @large egg{1}, @milk{1%cup}, @unsalted butter{2%tbsp} (melted), and @vanilla extract{1/2%tsp}. Add the wet ingredients all at once to the dry ingredients.

Mix and knead to make a soft dough. Cover and let rest for ~resting{5%minutes}.

== Knead and Rise ==

Knead the dough for ~kneading{6-8%minutes} until smooth and soft.

Place the dough in a lightly greased #large bowl{}. Turn to coat the top with oil. Cover and let rise for ~first rise{1 1/2-2%hours} until doubled in bulk.

== Shape the Doughnuts ==

Deflate the dough and turn it out onto a lightly floured surface. Gently roll it 1/4 inch thick.

Cut out doughnuts with a 2 1/2 to 3 inch #round cutter{}.

> Re-roll scraps once to cut additional doughnuts. Over-working the scraps makes tough doughnuts.

Cover loosely with greased plastic wrap and let rise for ~second rise{30-60%minutes} until doubled.

== Fry ==

Heat @peanut oil{6%cups} or vegetable shortening in a #heavy frying pan{} or #skillet{} to 350°F.

Carefully place the doughnuts in the oil, 2 or 3 at a time. Fry until golden brown, then turn over and cook the second side. Each side should take about ~frying per side{1%minute}.

Remove from the oil with a #slotted spoon{} and drain on absorbent paper.

== Finish ==

Fill or frost doughnuts as desired. For a simple finish, dredge in a mixture of @granulated sugar{} and @ground cinnamon{} while still warm, or dip in a glaze made from @powdered sugar{} and @milk{}.

metadata.title: Yogurt Chicken
metadata.description: Yogurt marinated chicken thighs with lemon and herbs.

steps: In a large bowl, whisk together 1/2 cup Greek yogurt, 1 lemon zest, 1 lemon juice, 2 tbsp garlic (fresh chopped), 2 tbsp fresh herbs (such as parsley and chives, chopped), 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp black pepper.
Place 2 lbs chicken thighs (boneless skinless) in the marinade and ensure they are fully coated. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to overnight.

sections.title: Cook
steps: Preheat oven to 400F. Remove 2 lbs chicken thighs from marinade, place on a baking sheet, and bake for 25 minutes or until cooked through.

metadata.title: Yogurt Granola Bowl
metadata.description: Yogurt Granola Bowl

metadata.longDescription: A simple, satisfying yogurt bowl with crunchy granola, fresh fruit, honey, and walnuts. Adjust fruit based on what's in season.

sections.title: Base Bowl
steps: In a bowl, add 170 g whole milk Greek yogurt(about 3/4 cup).
Top with 45 g granola(about 1/3 cup), 14 g walnuts(roughly chopped), 1 tablespoon honey, and a pinch of sea salt.

sections.title: Fruit Options
steps: Add one or more of the following:

metadata.title: Yu Xiang Eggplant
metadata.description: Sichuan fish-fragrant eggplant stir-fried with ground pork in a spicy, sweet, sour, and savory sauce.
metadata.nutrition-note: Oil absorption varies by eggplant variety, use less oil for a lighter dish. Skip the pork and add shiitake mushrooms for a vegan version.
metadata.long_description: Yu xiang (鱼香) means "fish-fragrant", but there's no fish. The name comes from the classic Sichuan sauce originally used for braised fish: doubanjiang, garlic, ginger, scallion, vinegar, sugar, and chili. It's one of the great flavor profiles of Chinese cooking. Based on recipes from The Woks of Life and Omnivore's Cookbook.
metadata.longDescription: Yu xiang (鱼香) means "fish-fragrant", but there's no fish. The name comes from the classic Sichuan sauce originally used for braised fish: doubanjiang, garlic, ginger, scallion, vinegar, sugar, and chili. It's one of the great flavor profiles of Chinese cooking. Based on recipes from The Woks of Life and Omnivore's Cookbook.

sections.title: Make the Sauce
steps: In a measuring cup, combine 1/2 cup chicken stock, 1 tablespoon doubanjiang(spicy fermented bean paste, Pixian if you can find it), 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon Shaoxing wine, 2 teaspoons sugar, 2 teaspoons oyster sauce, 1 teaspoon toasted sesame oil, 1 teaspoon Chinkiang vinegar(Chinese black vinegar, or rice vinegar), and 1/8 teaspoon white pepper. Stir to combine.

sections.title: Prep the Eggplant
steps: Wash 1 lb Chinese eggplants(2-3 long eggplants). Cut off the ends and slice on a sharp angle into bite-sized triangular pieces. This shape gives more surface area for the sauce to cling to.
> If using globe eggplant, soak the pieces in salted water for 10-15 minutes first, then drain and pat dry. This draws out moisture and prevents oil-sponge behavior.

sections.title: Sear the Eggplant
steps: Heat a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 tablespoon neutral oil and swirl to coat. Add the eggplant in a single layer and sear until browned on all sides, 7-10 minutes sear. Add another splash of oil if the eggplant looks dry. Add a splash of water or Shaoxing wine to speed cooking if needed.
Transfer the eggplant to a plate. It should be tender but still hold its shape.

sections.title: Cook the Pork
steps: Increase heat to high. Add 1 tablespoon neutral oil and 4 oz ground pork. Cook, breaking into small pieces, until browned and slightly crispy. Transfer to a plate.

sections.title: Build the Flavor Base
steps: Reduce heat to medium. Add 1 tablespoon neutral oil, 1/2 teaspoon minced ginger, and 10 dried Chinese chili peppers(whole). Stir for 1 minute until the chilies are toasted and fragrant.
> For extra heat, split a few chilies open to release the seeds.
Increase heat to high. Add 4 cloves garlic(finely chopped), the white portions of 2 scallions(cut on an angle into 2-inch pieces, white and green separated), and the cooked pork. Toss quickly.

sections.title: Combine
steps: Add the seared eggplant and the sauce. Stir gently and let cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce comes to a simmer.
Stir 2 teaspoons cornstarch(mixed with 1 tablespoon water) to recombine, then add about half to the sauce. Stir until thickened, add more slurry if too thin, a splash of water if too thick.
Add the green portions of the scallions and toss. Serve immediately over steamed rice.

> If using globe eggplant, soak the pieces in salted water for 10-15 minutes first, then drain and pat dry. This draws out moisture and prevents oil-sponge behavior.

== Sear the Eggplant ==

Heat a #wok{} or #large skillet{} over medium-high heat. Add @neutral oil{1%tablespoon} and swirl to coat. Add the eggplant in a single layer and sear until browned on all sides, ~sear{7-10%minutes}. Transfer the eggplant to a plate. It should be tender but still hold its shape.

== Cook the Pork ==

metadata.title: Zucchini Bread
metadata.description: A delightful way to incorporate vegetables into your diet, with a moist texture and subtle sweetness.

sections.title: Prepare Dry Ingredients
steps: In a large bowl, whisk together 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 tsp baking soda, 0.5 tsp baking powder, 0.5 tsp salt, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, and 0.5 tsp ground nutmeg. Set aside.

sections.title: Combine Wet Ingredients
steps: In another large bowl, beat together 0.5 cup vegetable oil, 1 cup granulated sugar, and 0.5 cup brown sugar packed, until well combined.
Add 3 eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Stir in 2 tsp vanilla extract.
Fold in 2 cups grated zucchini (about 2 medium zucchinis) until evenly distributed.

sections.title: Make the Batter
steps: Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, stirring until just combined.
> Do not overmix the batter or the bread will become dense.
Fold in the 0.5 cup chopped walnuts or raisins if desired.
> Optional add-ins: chopped walnuts, raisins, or chocolate chips.

sections.title: Bake
steps: Preheat oven to 350F (175C). Grease a loaf pan (9x5-inch) or line it with parchment paper.
Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan and smooth the top. Bake for 60 minutes to 70 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.

sections.title: Cool and Serve
steps: Allow the zucchini bread to cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely.
Slice and enjoy. Great for breakfast, snacks, or dessert.

Add @eggs{3} one at a time, beating well after each addition. Stir in @vanilla extract{2%tsp}.

Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, stirring until just combined.

> Do not overmix the batter or the bread will become dense.

Fold in the @chopped walnuts{0.5%cup} or raisins if desired.

> Optional add-ins: chopped walnuts, raisins, or chocolate chips.

Preheat #oven{} to 350F (175C). Grease a #loaf pan{1} (9x5-inch) or line it with parchment paper.
